Strategic Customer Success Manager

A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

As our first EMEA Strategic Customer Success Manager, you’ll help define what strategic success looks like at incident.io, and become the trusted partner who makes us core to how the biggest enterprises run reliability.

What that looks like day to day

You’ll work with a small number of our largest, most complex and highest-value customers. These are established, often global and regulated enterprises, where buying decisions take time, many business units are involved, and incident management is part of a wider move away from legacy tools and processes. You’ll be their strategic partner across the full lifecycle, from early involvement in the deal with Sales through to adoption and expansion, and from the on-call engineer to the CIO and CTO.

You’ll help land strategic logos with focused first contracts, then build the business case and success plan that turns them into larger deals. From there you’ll expand across the enterprise, mapping the organisation, finding champions and repeating proven wins across business units and regions. You’ll run Executive Business Reviews and connect our leadership with theirs, tying what we do to what matters to their business: operational resilience, regulatory risk, the cost of downtime, tool consolidation, MTTR reduction and incident process maturity.

You’ll lead onboarding and migrations in organisations that move carefully, moving them off legacy tools and ITSM-led processes and making the change stick, including deeper adoption across Response, On-call, Status Pages and our AI capabilities. You’ll spot and reduce business, operational and reputational risk before it becomes visible, and bring Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing and Support together around shared goals for each account, including expansion and renewals.

You’ll also work directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap and design partnerships. As the first EMEA Strategic CSM and third on the team overall, you’ll help define our strategic CS playbook, support high-stakes deals and help develop your peers as the segment grows.

Who you are

  • You have significant experience in Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management, managing strategic or Fortune 500-scale accounts in enterprise SaaS. Traditional enterprises like financial services, insurance, pharma, retail or private equity are ideal. Developer tooling, observability or incident management is a plus.

  • You’ve driven adoption, retention and expansion in large, complex accounts with many stakeholders, and you have results you can point to.

  • You know how to land small and grow large, turning a pilot or single business unit into a multi-BU footprint over a long sales cycle.

  • Building a business case doesn’t faze you, nor does navigating procurement, security, legal and change management in slow-moving organisations.

  • You’re confident with senior technical executives, running EBRs and strategic planning sessions, and just as comfortable going deep with SREs and platform engineers.

  • You’re technically fluent in modern engineering organisations, on-call, incident response, SRE practices and the observability and DevOps ecosystem, and you can translate it for business stakeholders.

  • You have strong commercial judgement, partner well with Sales on renewals and expansion, and get ahead of customer challenges rather than reacting to them.

  • You’re autonomous and comfortable with ambiguity. You’re excited to define the role, not just step into it.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We’re rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We’re all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we’re doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Les tâches citées ci-dessus ne sont pas exhaustives et peuvent être amenées à évoluer en fonction des besoins et de l’activité du service.

jobs.description:
Ingénieur·e de recherche en identification d'état pour les systèmes temps réel réactifs – CDD 3 mois

Présentation de Télécom SudParis :

Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

  • Conduire des travaux de recherche fondamentale et appliquée en informatique sur l’identification d’état et la détection des conditions de compétition dans les systèmes temps réel.

  • Étudier et développer des approches visant à améliorer la fiabilité et les performances des systèmes de réseaux distribués.

  • Mobiliser des modèles formels temps réel, des méthodes d’identification d’état et des stratégies de détection des conditions de compétition.

  • Contribuer au développement de nouvelles méthodes d’analyse et de vérification des systèmes temps réel.

Activités

 1. Mener des travaux de recherche sur l’identification d’état et la détection des conditions de compétition dans les systèmes temps réel

  • Participer activement et régulièrement aux réunions de l’équipe de recherche.

  • Collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe à la conduite des travaux scientifiques.

  • Modéliser des systèmes de réseaux distribués à l’aide d’automates temporisés (Timed Automata) et de machines à états finis temporisées (Timed Finite State Machines).

  • Spécifier et vérifier des propriétés temporelles, notamment les conditions de compétition, à l’aide de solveurs et d’outils de vérification formelle tels qu’UPPAAL.

  • Mettre en œuvre et évaluer des méthodes existantes de génération de séquences d’identification d’état pour les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées, notamment les séquences de synchronisation (synchronizing sequences), de détermination de l’état initial (homing sequences) et de distinction (distinguishing sequences).

  • Exploiter des techniques telles que les arbres de successeurs et les méthodes d’abstraction pour dériver des séquences d’identification d’état.

  • Concevoir de nouvelles stratégies d’identification d’état et de détection des conditions de compétition.

  • Réaliser des expérimentations, analyser les résultats et évaluer les performances des méthodes développées.

 

2. Valoriser et diffuser les résultats de recherche

  • Rédiger des articles scientifiques et contribuer à leur publication dans des revues et conférences internationales.

  • Présenter les résultats des travaux lors de conférences, séminaires, colloques et autres manifestations scientifiques.

  • Participer aux échanges scientifiques et contribuer à la diffusion des connaissances au sein de la communauté de recherche.

 

3. Contribuer aux activités d’enseignement et d’encadrement

  • Participer à l’encadrement des étudiants dans le cadre de projets de recherche, de travaux pratiques ou de projets académiques.

  • Contribuer aux activités d’enseignement en lien avec les domaines scientifiques du projet.


Formation

  • Doctorat ou PhD depuis moins de 3 ans

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables

  • Expertise scientifique : maîtriser l’analyse des systèmes temps réel réactifs et comprendre les liens entre les conditions de compétition et l’identification de l’état final.

  • Détection des conditions de compétition : maîtriser les concepts liés à la détection des conditions de compétition et à la théorie de la concurrence.

  • Vérification formelle : maîtriser les méthodes de vérification de la concurrence entre les entrées et les sorties dans les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées.

  • Identification d’état : maîtriser les concepts et les méthodes d’identification d’état, notamment les séquences de synchronisation et de distinction pour les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées.

  • Robustesse des séquences : analyser les conditions de robustesse des séquences d’identification d’état vis-à-vis des conditions de compétition.

  • Outils de vérification : utiliser des outils et solveurs de vérification formelle, notamment UPPAAL et Z3.

  • Programmation : mobiliser des compétences en programmation pour la mise en œuvre, l’expérimentation et l’évaluation des méthodes développées.

  • Langues : maîtriser l’anglais à l’écrit et à l’oral. La connaissance du français constitue un atout.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables

  • Les systèmes de réseau distribué et de Cloud sont envisagés comme cas d’études

  • connaissance et expérience pertinente en matière de réseaux, de cloud et de systèmes distribués seraient un atout.

Capacités et aptitudes

  • Curiosité et autonomie en recherche

  • Travail en équipe et collaboration

  • Rédaction (scientifique) et communication orale

  • Créativité et esprit critique

  • Gestion du temps

Indications de rémunération:

  • Fourchette indicative de rémunération (hors bonus annuel variable): 33.700- 45.000 euros bruts annuels, selon le profil et l’expérience (charges salariales réduites en secteur public).

Informations complémentaires et candidature

  • Date limite de candidature : 15 novembre 2026

  • Nature du contrat : CDD de 3 mois

  • Catégorie et métier du poste (usage interne): II - R, Ingénieur de recherche et développement ou A (fonction publique)

  • Poste ouvert aux métiers de niveau immédiatement inférieur (usage interne)

  • Localisation du poste: Palaiseau (91)

  • Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidats en situation de handicap

  • Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de la fonction publique et/ou aux contractuels

  • Conditions de travail : 44 jours de congés, télétravail possible, restaurant et cafétéria sur site, accessibilité en transport en commun (avec participation de l'employeur) ou proche des axes routiers, association du personnel et association sportive sur le campus

jobs.description:
CISO

Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Why is this role important for Pennylane?

Pennylane is building Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a newly created regulated subsidiary applying for ACPR authorisations as a payment institution and a financing company.

This step is foundational to delivering a comprehensive financial-services product for our clients, on a model that is robust, scalable, and supervision-ready.

From day one, the ACPR will expect PFS to demonstrate clear security governance, effective oversight of critical dependencies, and credible evidence of operational resilience - with a strong security-by-design approach.

How will you contribute to the project?

You will own PFS’s security governance and overall security and resilience policy, under the direct supervision of the Chief Compliance and Risk Officer.

Your contribution is to design a risk and control framework that is proportionate to PFS’s activity and regulatory expectations, and to ensure PFS can evidence "security by design" through auditable, inspection-ready artefacts.

In practice, this includes:

  • Policy alignment: ensure consistency between PFS and Pennylane SAS security policies, leveraging the group framework where appropriate while prioritising PFS’s regulatory obligations.

  • Security by design: translate requirements into actionable standards and control expectations, embedded into product and engineering delivery.

  • Operational resilience: shape incident-management and continuity expectations, ensure they are testable, and drive evidence of effective execution.

  • Oversight of key stakeholders: establish effective oversight of Pennylane SAS and key providers, with clear expectations, monitoring and remediation follow-through.

This is a role for a technically credible security leader with strategic judgement - with the technical depth to challenge architectures, controls and evidence, and the seniority to own governance and executive reporting.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?

  • Own PFS Information Security policy: define, maintain and continuously improve PFS security governance, standards and policy set.

  • Manage the PFS risk and control framework: maintain the security risk taxonomy, control objectives, key risks/KRIs, escalation thresholds, and evidence expectations.

  • Embed security-by-design into the Product/Tech development cycle: leverage Pennylane SAS policies and existing ways of working where applicable, ensuring PFS security requirements and regulatory obligations are reflected in the delivery lifecycle, change process and go/no-go decisions, without creating unnecessary process overhead.

  • Ensure operational resilience / continuity / testing: define resilience requirements and ensure end-to-end testing and exercises produce usable evidence and tracked remediation.

  • Manage outsourcing arrangements and audits: oversee security aspects of outsourcing arrangements (intragroup and third parties), ensure auditability and follow through on findings and remediation.

  • Provide executive-level reporting: deliver clear, decision-oriented reporting on information-security posture, incidents, resilience testing and remediation to PFS management and the Supervisory Board.

KPIs / signals:

  • Policy & standards effectiveness: evidence of adoption (e.g., security requirements consistently reflected in delivery artefacts for material initiatives) and reduction of recurring “same class” issues over time.

  • Core security KRIs (within risk appetite): a small set of measurable KRIs with thresholds and owners (e.g., critical vulnerability exposure, privileged-access exceptions, key third-party risks), tracked and escalated when outside appetite.

  • Resilience testing KPIs: tests/exercises executed vs plan; % of high-severity findings remediated within agreed timelines; retest completion for failed scenarios.

  • Incident classification & remediation tracking: consistent classification, timely escalation, and tracked remediation to closure (including post-incident action closure rate).

  • Audit follow-up tracking: audit findings/actions ageing, % overdue by severity, and executive visibility on the top overdue items.

  • Threat & vulnerability landscape monitoring: regular review of the external threat/vulnerability landscape and its concrete impact on PFS priorities (what changes in controls, monitoring, or roadmap).

Ramp-up / expectations during the probation period:

  • Establish the initial PFS security governance baseline (policy set, decision rights, reporting cadence).

  • Propose and align a first set of PFS security KRIs and risk appetite thresholds (with owners and escalation path).

  • Produce a first resilience testing plan (what is tested, frequency, evidence expected) and agree success criteria.

  • Put in place an incident classification approach and a remediation tracking routine that is audit-ready.

Profile we are looking for

Must-have

  • Fintech and/or Banking experience

  • Strong experience in information security, technology risk, cyber-risk or security assurance, with ownership of complex topics.

  • Proven ability to design and run security governance and a risk/control framework with audit-ready evidence.

  • Experience working with outsourced / third-party / group-shared technology services while retaining accountability.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level reporting.

  • Professional fluency in French and English.

Nice to have

  • Operational resilience experience, including DORA-aligned practices (incident management, continuity, testing, third-party oversight).

  • Knowledge of payment and authentication topics (SCA, strong authentication and account recovery patterns).

  • Exposure to PCI DSS scope and payment-card security concepts.

  • Payment fraud and transaction-monitoring familiarity (fraud patterns, controls, investigations, and collaboration with Fraud/AML stakeholders).

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Laurent (1h), Chief Risk & Compliance Officer

3. Case Study with Laurent and Léa (1h)

4. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min)

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager (France)

We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person.

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

What we value

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values:

Drive and Lead

You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn

The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care

We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being.

Speed and Change

By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment.

The Role

As Customer Success Manager in our France team, you are responsible for the successful, lasting use of the CM.com platform: from onboarding onwards, and as a strategic advisor to our customers. You coordinate a smooth launch, build a strong relationship and make sure customers adopt and get value from what they bought. Customer-centric thinking is part of your DNA.

You will onboard and implement products across our platform, in particular:

  • Business messaging channels (SaaS or API): WhatsApp Business, RCS for Business, Email, SMS and Voice, plus verification services (One Time Password, Mobile Identity)

  • Activate: Marketing Campaigns, Marketing Automation and CXP Predictions

  • Support: our customer care platform, a single stop shop solution combining AI agents built with CM Agent Builders (chat, voice, WhatsApp, email) with seamless escalation to a human agent

You see how these products work together and have the (technical) depth to advise customers on best practices that fit their needs. You focus on Enterprise organizations with a high volume of customer contact: financial services and insurers, utilities and logistics, retail, government, telecom, contact centers, IT resellers and software vendors.

You collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Account Management, fellow Customer Success Managers, Product, Development, Marketing and Tech Support.

You will

  • Support pre-sales cycles together with the Sales team, including product demonstrations

  • Ensure onboarding and run for customers, from basics to complex projects

  • Drive AI agents (built with CM Agent Builders) and omnichannel use cases from scoping to go-live and adoption

  • Manage the customer lifecycle: business reviews, CS meetings and continuous improvement

  • Deploy professional services and train customer stakeholders

  • Detect revenue optimization, upsell and cross-sell opportunities and work with the Account team on renewals

  • Contribute to the ongoing development of our success services and products, and look for new and better ways of servicing customers

  • Support trade show preparation and attendance when needed

  • Use and improve our internal tools (CRM, CSM tools) and actively use AI tools to improve your own work and share what works with the team

jobs.title: Law Clerk/Counsel
jobs.description:
Law Clerk/Counsel

About Teramind

Teramind is a global leader in workforce analytics, insider threat detection, data loss prevention (DLP), and business process optimization. We help organizations of all sizes protect sensitive data, ensure compliance, and optimize workforce performance. Our platform is trusted by enterprise clients across financial services, healthcare, government, and technology sectors worldwide.

About the Role

Teramind is growing rapidly, and so is the legal work required to support that growth. Our General Counsel manages a high volume of enterprise contracts, vendor agreements, compliance requirements, and commercial negotiations across North America, EMEA, and APAC. We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Law Clerk or Paralegal to serve as her right hand, taking ownership of operational legal tasks, enabling faster contract throughput, and ensuring no ball gets dropped.

This is a high visibility role in a lean, fast-moving legal function. You will work closely with the GC on everything from first pass contract review to research, documentation, and cross-functional coordination with Sales, Finance, and HR.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review, draft, and redline commercial agreements including MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, vendor contracts, and SaaS subscription agreements
  • Support the General Counsel in managing the contract pipeline: tracking status, deadlines, open items, and follow-ups
  • Conduct initial review of incoming customer and vendor contracts; flag non-standard terms and escalate as appropriate
  • Maintain and organize the contract repository; ensure executed agreements are filed, version-controlled, and accessible
  • Coordinate with outside counsel: prepare documents, manage communications, and track billing
  • Support responses to fraud inquiries, subpoenas, regulatory requests, and government correspondence
  • Assist with employment-related documentation including offer letters, severance agreements, and policy updates in coordination with HR
  • Conduct legal research on topics including data privacy, cross-border regulatory requirements, and SaaS commercial norms
  • Support the GC in educating internal stakeholders (particularly Sales) on contract standards, liability positions, and acceptable terms
  • Assist in maintaining and updating legal playbooks, contract templates, and standard operating procedures
  • Manage and organize legal holds and related documentation

Qualifications

Required:

  • Paralegal certificate, law degree, or J.D. (non-practicing or pre-bar)
  • 2–5 years of experience in a legal, law firm, or in-house corporate legal environment
  • Strong working knowledge of commercial contract structures and common SaaS agreement terms
  • Experience reviewing, redlining, and negotiating NDAs, MSAs, and vendor agreements
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; ability to translate complex legal concepts for non-legal audiences
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Proficiency with contract management tools, document management systems, and Microsoft Office / Google Workspace

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting a General Counsel or senior attorney in a tech or SaaS company
  • Exposure to data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2 context, HIPAA)
  • Familiarity with cross-border commercial agreements (EMEA, APAC)
  • Experience with e-signature platforms (DocuSign, Adobe Sign) and CLM tools
  • Background in or exposure to cybersecurity, DLP, or workforce analytics industries

What Success Looks Like in Year 1

  • Contract turnaround time reduced from 3–5 days to same-day or next-day for standard agreements
  • GC's time freed from first pass review and administrative coordination, redirected to strategic legal matters
  • Outside counsel spend meaningfully reduced
  • Contract repository fully organized and maintained
  • Sales team supported with faster legal responses, reducing deal friction and limiting exposure to unfavorable commercial terms

Compensation

Additional Information

Full-Time Argentina, Canada, Mexico, Poland

jobs.title: Automation Specialist, Customer Success
jobs.description:
Automation Specialist, Customer Success

At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Automation Specialist, Customer Success (Inbound)

At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers. We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

We are looking for an Automation Specialist, Customer Success (Inbound) who does more than answer the queue. We need someone who looks at how we work and asks how to make it faster, smarter, and less repetitive. This role is the first line of defense for our global customers, and it requires treating the inbound queue as a workflow to improve, rather than a stack of email to clear.

You’ll manage reactive volume for our digital segment, triage non-technical requests, and spot “at-risk” signals in customer communications. Just as important, you’ll bring ideas for automating the repetitive parts of that work and help build them, using our existing tools (Salesforce, Gainsight, and Front) alongside AI tools already available to you (Claude, Gemini, Rovo, and our in-built Slackbot).

What you will be doing:

  • Bring and pilot automation ideas: spot repetitive, high-volume patterns in the queue (triage, tagging, routing, drafting) and propose or build automations using Salesforce, Gainsight, Front, and AI tools like Claude, Gemini, Rovo, or Slackbot to handle them.

  • Use AI-powered tools daily to synthesize customer context and speed up the resolution of complex inquiries, moving beyond manual lookups.

  • Triage incoming requests to distinguish between support issues, strategic adoption blockers, and commercial opportunities.

  • Identify "at-risk" customers based on sentiment and inquiry type, escalating to leadership or specialized teams when necessary to prevent churn.

  • Guide customers to existing self-service resources (Community, Knowledge Base, Toolkits) to foster independence and faster time-to-value.

  • Utilize internal AI agents and Knowledge Base tools to retrieve answers efficiently and assist in drafting accurate, empathetic responses.

  • Own communication in the Customer Success inbound queue (email/slack/Jira), acting as the primary point of contact for non-technical customer inquiries.

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions in Salesforce and Gainsight to ensure a complete view of customer health.

  • Collaborate with the Finance and AR teams to quickly resolve billing or administrative blockers that frustrate customers.

  • Identify trends in inbound questions, turn recurring ones into automated responses, macros, or workflow rules the whole team can reuse, and share the pattern with the Content team for future toolkit creation.

  • Review and analyze the customer base to identify and surface growth opportunities to the Sales Account Executive based on inbound signals.

Here is what you will need to know/have: Successful candidates will have the following education, experience, and skills:

  • College degree (Bachelor or equivalent)

  • AI & Tech Savvy: Demonstrated ability to use AI and automation tools to streamline workflows, process information, and increase personal efficiency.

  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with a focus on empathy and clarity

  • Capacity to set correct expectations and manage issues to completion under time pressure

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to "triage" complex situations quickly

  • Multitask and prioritize tasks in a changing environment

  • Strong team mentality, utilizing internal and external resources strategically and tactically

Desired Experience, but not required

  • Experience in a high-volume customer-facing role (Support, Success, or Account Management)

  • Proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce) and ticketing platforms

  • Customer-facing experience within the EdTech industry or other software companies

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

  • Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

  • Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

  • The technology and tools you need to do your best work

  • Motivosity employee recognition program

  • A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

Strategic Sourcing Lead – Fulfillment - Brazil

About the Role

As a Strategic Sourcing Lead, you’ll lead a new global sourcing hub focused on finding the right contributors for complex AI projects that require specialized or hard-to-reach talent across a wide range of domains, from translation and localization to legal, medical, scientific, and technical fields.

This is a strategic, hands-on role within Fulfillment. You’ll define how the hub operates, develop the team, and partner with Recruitment and Delivery to build sourcing strategies ranging from complex searches to high-volume scaling. The team will work in a data-informed and AI-enabled environment, using technology to enhance research, outreach, analysis, and sourcing efficiency.

Your Impact

  • Design and execute creative sourcing strategies for specialized, hard-to-reach, and high-volume needs.
  • Partner with Recruitment and Delivery to assess requirements, sourcing feasibility, and project needs.
  • Build relationships with production stakeholders and communicate risks, timelines, and expectations.
  • Use sourcing and conversion data to identify bottlenecks, test approaches, and improve funnel performance.
  • Embed AI and automation into sourcing workflows to improve research, outreach, analysis, efficiency, and scalability.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in sourcing, recruitment, talent acquisition, or a related field.
  • Experience leading or mentoring sourcing teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills across teams.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to guide sourcing decisions.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience sourcing for AI, data, or crowdsourcing projects.
  • Experience sourcing linguists, translators, or other language profiles across markets.
  • Experience working with global or distributed teams across time zones.
  • Flexibility to work regular U.S. hours or provide U.S. overlap when working in a different time zone.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

Retail Industry Principal

About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

The Opportunity

SINGU provides property and facilities management technology for organisations operating complex, multi-site estates. Retail is a strategically important market for the business, spanning shopping centres, retail parks, high-street portfolios, supermarkets, hospitality and other distributed consumer environments.

We are seeking an experienced retail property, facilities or operations leader to become SINGU's senior market authority for retail and help build a differentiated, commercially successful position in the sector.

The Retail Market Principal will combine deep industry expertise, executive credibility and market leadership with clear commercial accountability. The role will help SINGU determine where it has the strongest right to win, create access to senior decision-makers, originate strategic opportunities, accelerate priority deals and strengthen SINGU's relevance across the retail property and facilities ecosystem.

This is not a conventional sales, pre-sales, product marketing or communications role. It is a senior, market-facing position for someone who understands retail property and operations at practitioner level and can translate that experience, credibility and network into measurable commercial impact.

Success will be measured not simply through market visibility or activity, but through SINGU's ability to create qualified pipeline, win strategic customers, expand existing relationships and establish a repeatable position within priority retail segments.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, you will have established a clear and credible retail go-to-market strategy, identifying the segments and use cases where SINGU can win disproportionately and building meaningful executive relationships across priority retail accounts.

You will have originated and influenced significant qualified pipeline, contributed demonstrably to both new-logo and expansion revenue, and developed repeatable retail propositions supported by clear customer evidence.

You will also have strengthened SINGU's network of retail customers and advocates, while materially increasing our credibility, relevance and market position within the retail property and facilities sector.

What You Will Own

Retail Market Strategy:

  • Define where SINGU has the strongest right to win across retail.

  • Shape our retail go-to-market strategy, priority segments, use cases and target accounts.

  • Maintain a strong point of view on the operational, regulatory and technology issues shaping retail estates.

  • Translate market insight into clear commercial and product priorities.

Executive Access and Market Development:

  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across retail property, facilities, operations, asset management and transformation.

jobs.description:
Product Builder - Mo (AI health companion)

🤖 Who we are

We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone.

We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖.

We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

 

🚀 Why we need you

Mo’s scope is expanding fast: inside Alan (a new Clinic, new capabilities), across the countries we operate in, and at the interfaces with many other Alan experiences. To get this expansion right, and to keep ownership distributed within the team, we’re looking for a Product Builder to take on a real share of that complexity and ambiguity.

You’ll own end-to-end one slice of Mo’s product scope. Depending on your profile, it could be:

  • 🩺 Mo for reactive care. Build all the integrations between Mo, our Clinic and the healthcare system, and shape how our medical team interacts with members in and through Mo.

  • 🛡️ Mo for insurance. Make Mo the main interface between members and Alan, building on our Support AI agents, across channels and countries.

  • 🌍 Mo global. Adapt Mo to new countries and find the right operating model for each (medical reviews, safety, local features).

  • ➕ Mo as a platform. Make Mo the companion other teams build upon, so our domain experts can ship their own experiences through it.

🎯 Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for Product Builders with around 5+ years of experience who want to build state-of-the-art AI products and apply them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

  • You’ll own a product area end-to-end: problem framing, vision, prioritisation, shipping, and measuring whether we actually help members get and stay better.

  • You’ll work daily with engineers, ML engineers, data, and doctors, at the frontier of LLMs and agentic systems, and see your work in production with real people.

  • You’ll navigate ambiguity and many stakeholders across Alan, and turn it into clear decisions and a focused roadmap.

  • You’ll be hands-on: prototyping, digging into data, reading conversations and evals, getting into the technical details with the team.

  • You’ll contribute to our product culture and help build the team (hiring, interview loops, etc.).

You would be a good fit in Mo if most of this sounds like you:

  • Experience building and shipping a live AI/LLM product

  • Very hands-on, comfortable with technical and data topics (SQL, prototyping, understanding how an LLM system behaves and fails)

  • Interest or experience in one or several medical or prevention themes

  • Product-minded and outcome-driven: you care about impact, not output

  • Self-directed, pragmatic, driven, hard working

  • Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

  • Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching

  • Fluent in English

  • Ex-engineers and ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus

 

🤘 How we do it ?

We benefit from Alan’s platform, infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise — but operate with the speed and focus of a startup. If you’re curious about Alan’s broader vision, our Shareholder Letters are worth a read.

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

 

How we work: our Leadership Principles

  • Mission is the Boss — We think long-term and are methodical optimists who take risks, seeking our mission's success above all else.

  • Distributed Ownership — Accountable enlightened despots: everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radical Transparency — All information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

  • Always Growing — Direct, positive, and caring feedback, combined with self-growth ownership.

 

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

 

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

jobs.description:
Stage Assistant(e) chef de projet événementiel (H/F/X) - Lyon

Lieu :    Lyon                                                                           Date souhaitée de démarrage :  11/01/2027

Durée :  6 mois                                                             

« S’engager aux côtés d’HI, c’est agir pour venir en aide aux populations vulnérables que nous soutenons sur le terrain. Pour mener à bien cette mission, nous recherchons des étudiants motivés et prêts à mettre leur énergie au service d’une cause qui a du sens »

HI, Humanité & Inclusion est une organisation de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et des populations vulnérables, elle agit et témoigne, pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels, pour améliorer leurs conditions de vie et promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux.

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap.  

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens. 

 

Pour plus d’information sur l’association : www.hi.org

 

OBJECTIFS DU STAGE :

Le stage se fera au sein du service Sensibilisation - Communication de Handicap International, au siège de Lyon, dans le cadre des missions quotidiennes du service avec un large volet dédié à l’organisation des déploiements des Pyramides de chaussures. Être un soutien au service Sensibilisation - Communication dans leurs actions de sensibilisation et tout projet. 

Nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant : l’Espace du bénévolat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International.

La mission se déroulera du 11 janvier au 10 juillet 2027 (6 mois).

Les Pyramides de chaussures c’est le temps fort de sensibilisation et de mobilisation citoyenne pour Handicap International. Depuis plus de 30 ans, tous les citoyens, scolaires, salariés d’entreprises, sympathisants de Handicap International ou encore politiques sont invités à venir :

-          Lancer leurs chaussures pour témoigner de leur soutien aux causes portées par Handicap International, la chaussure symbole de l’engagement citoyen pour protéger les civils ;

-          S’informer à travers une exposition interactive, ludique et pédagogique sur Handicap International, ses champs d’intervention et ses combats ;

-          Rencontrer et échanger avec nos experts terrain

Depuis 2024 Handicap International a développé des Pyramides de chaussures dites « mobiles ». Le but ? Être présent toute l’année partout en France. Grâce à ce dispositif nous pouvons aller au plus proche de nos différentes cibles (scolaire, sympathisants, grand public, élus, médias) et leur proposer un temps de sensibilisation complet sur nos missions dans le monde. Pour en savoir plus sur les Pyramides : https://www.handicap-international.fr/fr/pyramides-de-chaussures

Le stage sera orienté autour de trois volets 

-          Appui à la prospection (recherche de structures hôtes ou de partenaires intéressés par des visites guidées)

-          Appui événementiel et logistique pour la préparation et le déroulement des déploiements.

-          Animation auprès du public (visites guidées, actions de sensibilisation, échanges lors d’évènements).

Le stage implique des déplacements réguliers (environ deux par mois) dans le cadre des animations et évènements extérieurs. Ces missions sont l’occasion de belles rencontres et d’échanges enrichissants avec des publics variés.

Le stage combine la prospection de nouveaux lieux de déploiement, l'appui à la coordination événementielle et logistique et l'animation auprès de publics variés. Une bonne connaissance des actions, des valeurs et des prises de position de Handicap International est nécessaire pour adapter les messages de sensibilisation au contexte géopolitique.

Activité 1 : Participer à la préparation et au déploiement des Pyramides de chaussures 2027

-          Prospection : identifier et contacter des villes, structures et partenaires susceptibles d'accueillir une Pyramide ; contribuer au suivi des contacts et des opportunités.

-          Coordination logistique : participer aux rétroplannings, à la préparation du matériel, à la mobilisation des bénévoles et à l'organisation opérationnelle des déploiements.

-          Relations avec les partenaires et prestataires : recherche de contacts, coordination, suivi des engagements, communication et fidélisation.

-          Participation aux événements en France : appui à la coordination sur place, installation et démontage, animation de visites guidées, prises de parole et échanges avec les publics.

-          Bilans et capitalisation : recueillir les retours d'expérience, contribuer aux bilans et à l'amélioration des outils et procédures.

Activité 2 : Soutenir l'organisation d'événements portés par d'autres services

-          Appuyer, selon les besoins, la logistique, la communication ou la prospection pour des événements transversaux (par exemple : vœux, inauguration des nouveaux locaux, Congrès des Notaires ou autres temps forts de l'association).

Activité 3 : Participer à la vie quotidienne du service sensibilisation – communication

-          Contribuer à la gestion de boîtes mail et au suivi des sollicitations, au suivi d'actions solidaires et à la préparation de nouvelles actions ou événements de mobilisation

-          Contribuer à l'animation et au déploiement du défi de Damien Seguin pour l'inclusion et la solidarité internationale, avec un focus sur le volet scolaire : mobilisation et accompagnement des établissements scolaires, diffusion des outils pédagogiques, appui à l'organisation d'actions de sensibilisation et de défis solidaires, suivi des établissements participants et valorisation de leurs initiatives.

Requirements

Niveau Master

Intérêt marqué pour la solidarité internationale et volonté de connaître les actions et valeurs de Handicap International.

Gestion de projet événementiel

Intérêt pour la prospection et la prise de contact avec des partenaires et collectivités.

Aisance relationnelle (interventions orales et tel)

Une expérience associative ou bénévole serait un plus.

Bonne expression écrite et orale.

Goût pour le travail en équipe.

Organisation, rigueur, sens des priorités et capacité d'adaptation.

Bon sens, autonomie et prise d'initiative.

Benefits

CONDITIONS DU STAGE:

Vous recevrez :

·     Une gratification mensuelle de 693€ pour un stage temps plein, 6 mois (stage à partir du 11 janvier 2026)

·     Des tickets restaurant d’une valeur faciale de 8,96 euros (60 % à la charge de l’employeur, 40% à votre charge)

·     Une participation de 50% à votre abonnement au titre des transports

·     De nombreuses activités sportives et sociales sont proposées dans nos locaux 

 

Vous devez disposer d’une convention de stage obligatoire délivrée par un établissement d’enseignement ou de formation français.

ACCESSIBILITE DU LIEU DE TRAVAIL :  

Les locaux sont facilement accessibles en transports en commun (bus, métro). Un parking voitures et un parc à vélos sont également à disposition. Au sein du bâtiment, des rampes d'accès et ascenseurs garantissent une meilleure circulation.  Tous les postes de travail sont situés en Open Space mais des box sont disponibles à chaque étage pour travailler dans le calme si nécessaire. L’espace de travail est très lumineux.

Une référente handicap est présente pour répondre aux éventuelles questions et vous accompagner dans vos démarches. En fonction de vos besoins, le poste peut être aménagé.

 

Envoyez votre candidature directement à :

Seuls les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront contacté(e)s.

Clinical Research Associate II

Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease.

We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages. CRAs join us, love their jobs, and stay because of the amazing people and enjoyable quality of life. You will have a lower than average number of protocols, setting you up to be a protocol expert. Travel is reasonable and your work/life balance will benefit as a result. Most meaningfully - your voice will be heard. Working in a smaller CRO allows you to have influence and impact when it matters most and support from direct line management.

We are now recruiting Clinical Research Associate II to join our team in the Netherlands. This is a remote based position with travel to sites for morning visits. We are looking for candidates based in the Netherlands with biopharma monitoring experience.

About you:

  • You are calm, thoughtful, and responsive when things don’t go as planned.
  • You are well-prepared, whether it be for an investigator meeting, site visit or project team update, always staying two steps ahead of the game.
  • You find quick and creative ways of overcoming difficulties.
  • You have an impeccable eye for detail.
  • You identify potential study risks and propose solutions on how to mitigate them.
  • You take responsibility in the quality and outcomes of your work.
  • You are adept at handling conflict by using tried and true resolution strategies.

How we will keep you busy and support your growth:

You will monitor and own the progress of clinical studies at investigative sites and ensure that clinical studies are conducted, recorded, and reported per protocol, SOPs, ICH-GCP, and all applicable regulations and standards. You will coordinate all necessary activities required to set up and monitor a study (i.e., identify investigators; helping prepare regulatory submissions, conducting pre-study and initiation visits, etc.).

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Life science degree and / or equivalent experience
  • 2 years or more as a CRA in either a CRO or pharmaceutical/biotech industry or equivalent, relevant experience and/or demonstrated competencies. Site management or equivalent experience in clinical research.
  • Availability for domestic travel including overnight stays, as required (international travel may be required for some senior level positions)

Other Required:

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills are essential. A team player.
  • Evidence of a client focused approach
  • Availability for domestic travel including overnight stays, which may constitute up to approximately 50-60% travel commitment (international travel may be required for some senior level positions)
  • Fluency in English, Dutch

  • oncology monitoring experience will be a plus

Preferred:

Software Engineer

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer II to help build product features that power financial services. You'll work on systems that handle payments, credit, and other core products that our customers rely on daily to drive business operations.

✅ What You’ll Do

  • Own the full lifecycle of medium-sized features and tasks across our product stack
  • Build user-facing features, internal tools, APIs, and backend services
  • Write clear, maintainable, and tested code that you'll be responsible for long-term
  • Participate in code reviews and provide timely feedback to teammates
  • Build features with the end product and user in mind, not just the code
  • Reason carefully about how your work extends in service of larger product needs
  • Build upon systems and features that others depend on
  • Balance speed with reliability and compliance in a regulated environment
  • Collaborate with other engineers and product team members to deliver high-impact work

⚡️What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Have strong fundamentals in software development and ability to work effectively within established systems
  • Product sense—you think about the user impact and business value of your work
  • Ability to take responsibility for the maintenance and quality of what you build
  • Experience with financial services, regulated industries, or handling sensitive data is a plus but not required
  • Ability to research and proactively solve problems, bring solutions to the table
  • English proficiency
  • A strong work ethic

Technical environment: We primarily use Typescript, PostgreSQL, and GCP. We are building in a monorepo with a lean towards rapid value creation through trunk based development. Deploying to production 3-5 times a week is the average velocity of a team member.

What matters to us: We value ownership, product sense, and clear communication. You should be someone who thinks beyond just shipping code to understanding the impact on users and the business. We're a small team, so everyone wears multiple hats and jumps in where needed.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

Flight Software Architect
jobs.description:
Flight Software Architect

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

The Flight Software Architect plays a key role in defining and maintaining the software architecture for our spacecraft flight software. The role ensures that the flight software architecture meets mission needs, system-level requirements, and safety and reliability objectives, while remaining scalable, maintainable, and suitable for the evolving needs of our spacecraft platforms. Working closely with Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and other functional disciplines, the Flight Software Architect drives architectural decisions, technical consistency, and the integration of software across the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as Flight Software Architect, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

What we would love to see from you

  1. Software architecture & design — Define, develop, and maintain the overall flight software architecture, including software components, interfaces, data flows, and execution models, ensuring alignment with spacecraft system architecture and mission objectives.

  2. Technical leadership & architectural decisions — Drive key architectural decisions and establish design principles, technical standards, and best practices for flight software development. Provide technical guidance to software engineers and ensure consistency across software components and development activities.

  3. System integration & interfaces — Define and coordinate software interfaces with avionics, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, GNC, communication systems, and other spacecraft subsystems. Ensure robust integration across functional disciplines and support the resolution of cross-system technical challenges.

  4. Requirements & traceability — Translate mission and system-level requirements into software architectural requirements, design constraints, and interface specifications. Ensure traceability between requirements, architecture, implementation, and verification, working closely with Systems Engineering and functional chain owners.

  5. Reliability, safety & performance — Ensure that architectural decisions address fault tolerance, robustness, timing constraints, resource utilization, failure detection and recovery, and overall spacecraft reliability. Contribute to safety analyses, failure management strategies, and the definition of appropriate software verification and validation approaches.

  6. Verification, validation & technical risk management — Identify and mitigate architectural risks, assess technical trade-offs, and support design reviews, integration campaigns, and verification activities. Ensure that the architecture is validated against mission requirements and that critical technical assumptions are verified early in the development lifecycle.

  7. Cross-functional collaboration & technical communication — Act as a technical reference for flight software architecture, facilitating alignment between Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and external partners, including ESA where applicable. Communicate architectural decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and project stakeholders.

In the role of Flight Software Architect, ideally, you will have the following:

  • 10–15 years of professional experience in software engineering, including substantial experience in flight software, embedded software, or safety- and mission-critical systems.

  • Proven experience defining and evolving software architectures for complex critical software systems, ideally for spacecraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or other aerospace applications.

  • Strong knowledge of real-time embedded software, operating systems, hardware–software interfaces, resource-constrained computing, and distributed or fault-tolerant systems.

  • Experience translating system-level requirements into software architectures, interface specifications, and verification strategies.

  • A solid understanding of software integration, testing, verification and validation, and configuration and change management in a complex engineering environment.

  • Experience with architectural trade-off analysis, technical risk management, and making sound engineering decisions under performance, reliability, schedule, and resource constraints.

  • The ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines and align stakeholders around clear technical solutions.

  • Strong structured thinking, analytical skills, and the ability to simplify complex technical challenges into robust and maintainable architectures.

  • Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions, document design rationale, and provide technical guidance to multidisciplinary teams.

  • A strong ownership mindset, a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, and a passion for developing reliable software that enables humanity’s exploration of space.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Agents (m/f/x)

About this role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role

  • Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.

  • Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.

  • Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.

  • Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.

  • Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.

  • Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.

  • Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.

  • The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.

  • Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.

  • Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it.

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.

  • A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.

  • Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.

  • Fluency in English is a must.

What we offer

  • Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.

  • Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.

  • A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.

  • Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.

  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

  • Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.

  • We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

About Eye Security

 

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

 

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

 

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree across conversion and expansion – lead-to-funded conversion, time to fund, time to first top-up, multi-product rate, share of wallet – and you are accountable for net new money from the segment, not for a single funnel stage.
