You shape the first-product strategy – which entry offer converts which persona – and make sure the brand promise and premium positioning carry through every step that builds trust and drives conversion.

  • Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Turn first-time investors into multi-product clients: top-ups and savings plans, second portfolios, additional account types and access to new asset classes such as private markets. You find natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build the in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove impact with causal measurement rather than correlation stories.

  • Hybrid Where It Pays Off: Define when a human touch turns a hesitant prospect into a client or a single-product client into a long-term relationship – callback offers at checkout drop-off, advisor triggers at wealth thresholds, and a clean handover to our Private Wealth team as clients grow. Every human touchpoint is designed, triggered and measured, not left to chance.

  • Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops, working closely with Marketing and Sales. Y ou build on shared onboarding and banking infrastructure owned by our platform teams, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for digital wealth growth at LIQID.

What you bring

  • Background: 7+ years in Product Management or Growth for digital consumer products, with ownership of both conversion and monetization or expansion outcomes. FinTech, WealthTech, banking or subscription businesses are a strong plus.

  • Growth & Analytical Depth: Hands-on with funnel, cohort and LTV analysis. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, can query data yourself, and know the difference between a significant result and a lucky one.

  • Technical & AI Fluency: Experience working with product analytics and CRM data. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype, analyze and ship faster.

  • Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and capital markets, and an understanding that converting someone to invest a significant share of their wealth is a trust decision, not an impulse purchase.

  • Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English, able to align Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Sales around one growth agenda and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership. Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. Y ou want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to build the growth engine of a digital-first wealth manager in an AI-native product organization.

What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget up to €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.

What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Call with Head of Product: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Take-home Assessment with live Presentation round: A take home task, followed by a 90-minute live session with two team members.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our Head of Product to discuss final alignments.

 

About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

jobs.title: Member Experience Training & Quality Specialist - UK
jobs.description:
Member Experience Training & Quality Specialist - UK

Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

The Member Experience Training & Quality Specialist makes the Neko member experience standard real on the ground. You deliver our member experience training to teams across the business, primarily clinic teams and centralised support teams, and you run the quality assurance activity that tells us whether the standard is actually landing in practice.

This is a delivery role at the heart of a live culture change programme. You will facilitate training that shifts mindset, not just process, run experience audits against CARE and the Member First Manifesto, and turn what you see into coaching and improvement. As markets scale, you keep the standard consistent across every site and cohort, and rising over time.

You own the coordination and logistics that keep training and quality assurance running: scheduling sessions and audits, and organising the people, spaces and materials each one needs. You report to the Hospitality Programme Lead and support the wider rollout, so you will also play a hands-on part in projects and launch activity as new clinics and teams come online.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Stage 1 and Stage 2 member experience training delivered consistently to every new clinic cohort in your market, with 30-day reviews showing the mindset shift is landing, not just attendance being logged. (Member First, always)

  • A regular quality assurance rhythm is live: experience audits across clinic and support teams, scored consistently against CARE and the Member First Manifesto, with clear findings shared back to the teams and their leads. (Impact, not activity)

  • Audit insight turned into action: recurring friction points named early and at least two concrete experience improvements implemented with clinic and support leads. (Optimistic truth-seeking)

  • Support team training built out and delivered alongside clinic training, so centralised member support holds the same standard as the clinic floor. (Chase 10X, not 10%)

  • The ongoing learning ecosystem running smoothly, including the monthly AI role play and quiz, with completion tracked and shared with Clinic Leads as a coaching tool, not a performance measure. (Tech-enabled, human-centred)

  • A training and audit calendar owned end to end: sessions scheduled around clinic rotas and cohort timing, facilitators, rooms, materials and joining details arranged, and audits planned on a set cadence so every site and team is covered without gaps. (Impact, not activity)

Minimum Requirements

  • 3+ years in training delivery, learning and development, hospitality, or member and customer experience, ideally in a high-touch service, hospitality, or premium retail environment.

  • A confident facilitator, comfortable leading a room of clinicians and operators and holding attention and energy across a full-day session.

  • Hands-on experience running quality assurance or experience audits, mystery shopping, or service standard reviews, with the ability to score consistently and give feedback that changes behaviour.

  • A sharp eye for service detail and what separates a good experience from an exceptional one, drawn from service design and hospitality thinking rather than process alone.

  • Organised and self-directed, able to run a training and audit calendar across multiple sites and cohorts without dropping the standard.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the credibility to influence teams and leads who do not report to you.

  • Willingness to travel regularly between clinic sites, and occasionally between markets.

  • Experience supporting a multi-site clinic, hospitality, or retail rollout as it scales.

  • Experience with digital learning tools, an LMS, or AI-enabled training and assessment.

  • Confident with everyday workplace tools, including Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook, to build training materials, track audits and report findings.

Hiring Process

Candidates progress from application and structured screening through thoughtfully designed interviews culminating in a formal offer and final pre-employment checks before joining the team.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion Statement

Neko Health is committed to inclusive hiring and member-first care. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to request reasonable adjustments to support your application.

jobs.title: Financial Services Regulatory Lead H/F
jobs.description:
Financial Services Regulatory Lead H/F

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!


Why is this role important for Pennylane?

Pennylane is building Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a newly created regulated subsidiary applying for ACPR authorisations as a payment institution and a financing company.

From day one of licensing, PFS must be able to operate in full regulatory compliance - not only through policies, but through reliable execution: clear ownership, predictable reporting routines, auditable evidence, and effective coordination across Operations, Finance/Accounting and Compliance & Risk.

This role is critical to organise and run that regulatory function, with the ambition to progressively consolidate regulatory reporting ownership within PFS.

How will you contribute to the project?

You will help build and operate the regulatory office of Pennylane Financial Services, working across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology.

Your initial priority will be to turn PFS’s regulatory requirements into a reliable operating framework: a complete obligations inventory, clear ownership, an integrated regulatory calendar, and effective controls over regulatory reporting and evidence.

In practice, you will:

  • maintain the authoritative inventory of PFS’s regulatory obligations;

  • coordinate the regulatory-reporting portfolio and directly produce selected returns;

  • establish clear responsibilities, reporting controls and escalation paths across contributing functions;

  • support supervisory responses and commitment tracking from day one;

  • coordinate regulatory change with Compliance, Legal and the relevant subject-matter owners; and

  • support regulatory governance through clear reporting, decision tracking and follow-through.

You will not replace the specialist accountability of Finance, the MLRO, Legal, Risk or Operations. Your role will be to make their contributions converge into a controlled, timely and inspection-ready regulatory process.

As PFS grows, you will help shape and evolve its regulatory operating model and governance arrangements.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?

  • Maintain the regulatory-obligations inventory: keep a complete and current view of PFS’s recurring and event-driven obligations, with clear owners, deadlines, controls, approval routes and evidence requirements.

  • Run the integrated regulatory calendar: coordinate contributors, dependencies and review milestones across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology, escalating delivery risks before deadlines are affected.

  • Coordinate regulatory reporting: oversee the end-to-end reporting portfolio and directly prepare selected returns, while ensuring specialist functions retain accountability for their underlying judgements and data.

  • Establish reporting controls: document and operate source-to-report lineage, reconciliations, variance analysis, maker-checker review, sign-offs, submission evidence, correction procedures and backup arrangements.

  • Coordinate data-quality remediation: document reporting-data issues, assign them to the accountable function, monitor resolution and escalate overdue or recurring problems.

  • Support supervisory responses and commitment tracking: maintain a reliable record of requests, responses and commitments; coordinate contributions and evidence under the direction of the ACPR relationship owner; and escalate delivery issues to PFS management.

  • Coordinate regulatory change: work with Compliance, Legal and relevant subject-matter owners to translate new requirements into impact assessments, accountable owners, implementation plans and evidence.

  • Support regulatory governance: prepare concise status reporting, maintain decision and action tracking, and ensure regulatory matters reach the appropriate management or governance forum.

  • Improve tools and processes: define practical requirements for workflow, evidence storage, reporting production and regulatory remittance, reducing manual effort without weakening controls.

Profile we are looking for

Must-have

  • Meaningful experience in a regulated financial environment, in one or more areas such as regulatory reporting, regulatory operations, prudential reporting, compliance, risk, finance, internal control or regulatory advisory.

  • Strong understanding of reporting controls and data quality, including reconciliations, source-to-report traceability, review and approval controls, exception management and auditable evidence.

  • Sound regulatory judgement: ability to understand a requirement, identify its practical implications, recognise when specialist Legal or Compliance input is needed, and translate conclusions into ownership, processes and controls.

  • Strong execution discipline, with a demonstrated ability to coordinate recurring deliverables, manage interdependencies and meet fixed deadlines reliably.

  • Ability to work effectively across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Technology, while preserving clear accountability between functions.

  • Ability to build structured and durable ways of working—including registers, calendars, procedures, templates and knowledge bases—in an evolving environment.

  • Clear and concise written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain issues, assumptions and required decisions to senior stakeholders.

  • Professional fluency in French and English.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with ACPR reporting, supervisory interactions or the French regulatory environment.

  • Experience in a payment institution, electronic-money institution, financing company, bank, regulated fintech, supervisory authority or specialist advisory firm.

  • Exposure to more than one regulatory domain, such as payments, prudential reporting, statistical reporting, AML-CFT, fraud, incidents or financing activities.

  • Experience coordinating regulatory change, supervisory requests, inspections or remediation commitments.

  • Familiarity with regulatory-remittance tools, reporting-data lineage, workflow automation or evidence-management solutions.

  • Experience building or materially improving a regulatory framework in a new entity, licensing programme or operating-model transformation.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Simon (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Laurent (1h), Compliance&Risk Director

3. Case Study with two Finance or Legal representative (1h)

4. Team fit with two interviewers (30 min)

5. Last round with Maxime and Felix (45 min)

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Grâce à votre sens du terrain et votre capacité à fédérer, vous participerez activement au développement de projets qui font sens pour le territoire et ses habitants.


Vos missions

·         Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire.

·         Construire et maintenir un réseau local solide, incluant partenaires, collectivités et apporteurs d’affaires.

·         Formation Bac+5 : école de commerce, master en aménagement du territoire, urbanisme ou droit rural.

·         Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion de projets.

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ?

💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours.
🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance.
🌴 Une prime vacances.
🩺 Mutuelle famille financée à 50% 
🚗 Une voiture de fonction.
🏠 Un mode de travail flexible et hybride – dans nos bureaux modernes ou confortablement depuis chez vous.
📚 Des opportunités de développement professionnel dans le domaine du stockage d’énergie par batteries (BESS).
🏆 Un voyage collectif annuel avec l’ensemble du groupe Novar, une expérience inoubliable – travailler dur et célébrer ensemble.

À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. 

 

Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. 

 

Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain.

jobs.title: Vice President Product & Marketing Excellgene
jobs.description:
Vice President Product & Marketing Excellgene

About ExcellGene

ExcellGene is a Swiss biologics development company based in Monthey, innovating in mammalian cell protein expression and bioprocess development. The company develops cell lines (CHO and HEK) and processes that enable biotech and pharmaceutical clients to produce proteins, from early research to clinical use. Its edge is speed and protein expression know-how. ExcellGene also licenses its own proprietary cell hosts, CHOExpress and HEKExpress.

ARCHIMED took a majority stake in ExcellGene in late 2025.

The role

ExcellGene is hiring a Vice President Product & Marketing to build its product and marketing function and drive the next phase of growth. This is a new role, reporting into the Chief Executive Officer and part of the Executive Leadership Team, to turn product & strategy into a clear offer and steady demand, working side by side with the Vice President of Global Business Development & Sales and the Chief Scientific & Technology Officer

Key responsibilities

  • Market & customer insight: understand customers, market segments, competitors and emerging opportunities.
  • Portfolio & product strategy: shape portfolio around market needs and ExcellGene’s scientific strengths.
  • Positioning & value proposition: clearly articulate why customers should choose ExcellGene.
  • Go-to-market: define and drive GTM strategies for core business and new growth areas.
  • Demand creation: build effective lead-generation programs and targeted campaigns.
  • Sales enablement: equip Sales with insights, messaging and tools to win.
  • New growth platforms: identify and develop new organic opportunities and support the assessment and integration of potential acquisitions.
  • Team leadership: lead and develop the Marketing & Product team (3 people).

This person will connect market, portfolio, positioning, go-to-market and lead generation. He/she will decide where ExcellGene plays, why it wins, and where the next growth platforms come from.

Requirements

Must have

  • A scientific background and education, ideally combined with a business or marketing qualification.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in product and marketing, including 3-5 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong product and marketing experience in biologics. Cell-line development or protein expression is highly valued.
  • Experience in a CRO, CDMO or other scientific services business, selling development services alongside products.
  • Product marketing and broader marketing, with go-to-market experience at both strategic and hands-on level.
  • The ability to turn complex science into clear customer value and a sharp commercial offer.
  • A start-up mindset: think strategically, do the work yourself and bring an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach.
  • Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to work effectively with scientific, commercial and operational teams.

Nice to have

  • Good understanding of the US market and of Asian markets (India is a plus).

Benefits

  • Location: Monthey, Switzerland
  • Working model: Hybrid, on site 3 days per week, ideally Tuesday to Thursday

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
Product Safety & Certification Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems
jobs.description:
Product Safety & Certification Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems

About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable.

This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release

• Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals

• Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls

• Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams

• Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD)

• Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification

• Interface with notified bodies, certification authorities and customers on safety topics

• Promote a strong safety culture and coach teams on functional safety practices

 

Skills and Experience Required:

• BSc/MSc in electrical, electronic, mechatronic, control or safety engineering is mandatory

• Minimum 3-5 years of functional safety experience in industrial, energy or hydrogen systems

• Working knowledge of safety standards (ex. IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262 and/or IEC 62061)

• Hands-on experience with HARA, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA and safety requirements engineering

• Understanding of safety-related hardware, embedded software and control architectures

• Familiarity with hydrogen, high-voltage or pressure system safety is a strong plus

• Team player able to work autonomously with internal and external experts

• Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory; French/German is a plus

• Functional safety certification (e.g. TÜV FSEng) is a plus

 

Start date: Immediately

jobs.title: Cleanroom Equipment Technician
jobs.description:
Cleanroom Equipment Technician

Over ons

De halfgeleiderindustrie vraagt om steeds krachtigere chips: meer bandbreedte, minder energieverbruik. Onze technologie levert precies dat. Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is.

In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen.

De functie

Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken.

Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

  • Zorgdragen voor een veilige en betrouwbare werking van cleanroomvoorzieningen, waaronder HVAC, toevoer- en afvoerlucht, gas-, water- en elektrische infrastructuur.

  • Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, storingsanalyse en reparaties aan productie en test apparatuur in de cleanroom en cleanroom systemen en inkomende nutsvoorzieningen.

  • Technische problemen diagnosticeren en oplossen om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken en de operationele continuïteit te waarborgen.

  • Onderhoudswerkzaamheden coördineren en uitvoeren, met inachtneming van normen en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

  • Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor technische uitdagingen en proactief mogelijkheden identificeren voor systeemverbeteringen en een hogere betrouwbaarheid.

Jouw kwalificaties

  • Afgeronde beroepsopleiding in een mechanische, technische of onderhoud gerelateerde richting (bijvoorbeeld automonteur, industrieel monteur, mechatronicatechnicus of vergelijkbaar).

  • Praktische ervaring met mechanische systemen en basiskennis van elektrische, pneumatische, gas- of utiliteitssystemen.

  • Sterke hands-on mentaliteit met het vertrouwen om onbekende technische uitdagingen aan te pakken en nieuwe technologieën te leren.

  • Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken, prioriteiten te stellen en volledige verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor toegewezen taken.

  • Probleemoplossende instelling, sterke vaardigheden in storingsanalyse en bereidheid om te werken in een cleanroomomgeving met strikte kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen.

  • Comfortabel met praktisch werk in cleanroom-, laboratorium- en facilitaire omgevingen, inclusief het gebruik van ladders om verhoogde gebieden te bereiken en het werken in beperkte ruimtes onder de cleanroom wanneer dat nodig is.

  • In staat om fysiek veeleisende onderhouds- en installatiewerkzaamheden veilig uit te voeren, zoals het vervangen van HEPA-filters, het bedienen van afsluiters, het positioneren van gascilinders en het verplaatsen van zware vacuümpompen. Voor zware lasten worden geschikte hulpmiddelen en ondersteuning van collega’s ingezet.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels, bij voorkeur ook in het Nederlands om te kunnen communiceren met externe partijen, management en operators.

Ervaring in de halfgeleiderindustrie is niet vereist. Je ontvangt de nodige training en ondersteuning om de apparatuur te leren kennen en je technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen.

Hoe succes eruitziet

  • Volledige verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de cleanroominfrastructuur, en zorgen voor een betrouwbare werking van luchtbehandeling, gas-, water-, afzuig- en elektrische systemen met minimale stilstand.

  • Uitgroeien tot een vertrouwde technische expert binnen het team, door proactief problemen te signaleren, praktische oplossingen te implementeren en bij te dragen aan een veilige en efficiënte werkomgeving.

  • Sterke zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel tonen, door onderhouds- en reparatiewerkzaamheden zelfstandig te beheren en effectief prioriteiten te stellen in een dynamische omgeving.

  • Technische kennis en vaardigheden continu uitbreiden, snel nieuwe systemen en technologieën eigen maken en tegelijkertijd de hoge standaarden handhaven die vereist zijn binnen een cleanroomomgeving.

Onze werkcultuur

Mensen boven processen. Bij Black Semiconductor is flexibiliteit essentieel — wij zorgen ervoor dat werk zich aanpast aan het leven, en niet andersom. We stimuleren een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, waarin carrières betekenisvol en verrijkend zijn. Onze processen zijn mensgericht, zodat jij je kunt richten op wat echt belangrijk is.

Laten we samen groeien. Jouw potentieel staat bij ons centraal. We bieden de autonomie om blijvende impact te maken en ondersteunen jouw groei met een cultuur van continu leren. We investeren in jouw professionele én persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Jouw gezondheid en toekomst zijn belangrijk. Jouw welzijn heeft de hoogste prioriteit. Daarom bieden wij een uitgebreid arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket met uitstekende verzekeringen, een pensioenregeling en virtuele aandelenopties voor jouw mentale, fysieke en financiële gezondheid. Jouw gemoedsrust staat bij ons centraal — nu én in de toekomst.

Wij leven openheid. Samenwerking en inclusiviteit vormen de hoekstenen van onze cultuur. Wij geloven in openheid en bouwen aan vertrouwen en respect. Individualiteit is onze gezamenlijke kracht, die innovatie stimuleert en ons vooruit helpt.

Wij verbinden chips – en mensen. Wij moedigen gekwalificeerde kandidaten van iedere achtergrond aan om te solliciteren. We creëren een inclusieve en ondersteunende werkomgeving waarin samenwerking, innovatie en groei centraal staan. Sluit je aan bij ons team en maak deel uit van een organisatie die een verschil maakt in de industrie.

Kun jij jezelf zien in deze functie en binnen ons bedrijf? Laten we kennismaken.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer II - Poland

Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

We also offer:

  • 100% remote work
  • Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off
  • A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from
  • A MacBook set up and ready from day one, plus a $500 stipend to design your ideal workspace
  • Central European Time (CET) hours to support a balanced schedule for our Poland-based team
  • Equity in a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier VCs

About the role

As a Software Engineer II, you bring growing technical depth, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership of features and components across the product. You focus on building scalable, reliable systems, writing well-structured code, and contributing to solutions that deliver real customer value.

We are currently hiring Software Engineers II to join one of two teams within our Platform organization: Identity & Access Management (IAM) or API. One of the team’s key projects involves Keycloak, an open-source Identity and Access Management solution. The API team owns and improves the backend API layer that powers the Housecall Pro application, with a strong current focus on application performance and creating a fast, reliable user experience.

In this role, you will elevate team effectiveness by sharing knowledge, contributing to design and code reviews. Our team is passionate, empathetic, and committed to improving the lives of our service professionals, our Pros. Your impact will help strengthen our product, enhance user experiences, and support the long-term success of the people we serve.

jobs.title: AI Automation & Ops Lead
jobs.description:
AI Automation & Ops Lead

AI Automation & Operations Lead

Company: Nucleus Network
Location: Remote
Employment type: Full-time
Working hours: To be confirmed based on required US time-zone overlap

About Nucleus Network

Nucleus Network is built around a simple mission: introducing great people to great people. The business operates across three core areas:

  • Nucleus Advisory: A warm-introductions-as-a-service business that has made and tracked more than 10,000 introductions.
  • Nucleus Ventures: A venture capital firm incubated by Nucleus that deployed more than $54 million across 28 companies within 2.5 years.
  • Nucleus Community: An events business that hosted more than 70 experiences over the past year across New York City, Los Angeles, Miami, San Francisco, Las Vegas, Cannes, and other locations.

As Nucleus continues to grow, we are looking for someone who can help us use AI and automation to operate more intelligently, efficiently, and at scale.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly resourceful and hands-on AI Automation & Operations Lead to identify, build, and implement AI-powered workflows across Nucleus Network.

This is not a traditional machine-learning or AI research role. You will not be expected to build foundational AI models. Instead, you will use existing AI tools, automation platforms, APIs, and lightweight development to solve real operational problems.

You will work closely with the Nucleus leadership team to understand how different parts of the business operate, identify repetitive or inefficient processes, and turn those opportunities into reliable systems and automations.

A major initial focus will be improving how Nucleus captures, organizes, enriches, and uses relationship data. However, the role will eventually support processes across Nucleus Advisory, Nucleus Ventures, Nucleus Community, and other internal functions.

The ideal candidate is curious, technically capable, business-minded, and comfortable taking an ambiguous problem from idea to working solution.

What You’ll Do

Identify opportunities for AI and automation

  • Learn how different teams and business units at Nucleus currently operate.
  • Map existing workflows and identify repetitive, manual, or inefficient processes.
  • Recommend where AI and automation can create the greatest operational impact.
  • Prioritize projects based on business value, complexity, urgency, and scalability.
  • Help the leadership team distinguish between processes that should be automated and those that still require human judgment.

Build AI-powered workflows

  • Design and implement practical AI automations from start to finish.
  • Connect the different platforms used across the organization to create reliable, end-to-end workflows.
  • Use large language models and automation tools to extract, structure, classify, enrich, summarize, and route information.
  • Build lightweight internal tools, interfaces, dashboards, or applications when existing tools are insufficient.
  • Use APIs, webhooks, scripts, and no-code or low-code platforms to connect systems.
  • Evaluate and introduce new AI tools when they offer a clear business benefit.

Improve CRM and relationship management

  • Help build or improve Nucleus’s internal CRM and relationship-tracking systems.
  • Make it easier for team members to capture and update contact information.
  • Automate the enrichment and organization of contact and company data.
  • Create systems that identify stale relationships or incomplete records.
  • Develop lead-scoring workflows based on ideal customer profile fit.
  • Build systems that surface relevant relationship insights and recommend high-quality potential introductions.
  • Improve how Nucleus records, tracks, and analyzes introductions across the business.

Own implementation and maintenance

  • Translate loosely defined business needs into clear technical solutions.
  • Build prototypes quickly, gather feedback, and improve them through iteration.
  • Test automations carefully before deployment.
  • Monitor existing workflows and troubleshoot errors or performance issues.
  • Maintain and improve systems as tools, processes, and business needs change.
  • Build safeguards and human-review steps where accuracy or business judgment is important.
  • Document systems clearly so that other team members can understand and use them.

Drive adoption

  • Explain technical solutions clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Train team members on new workflows and tools.
  • Gather feedback from users and incorporate it into future improvements.
  • Create simple documentation and operating procedures.
  • Help establish practical standards for the responsible and secure use of AI across the organization.

Examples of Projects You May Work On

Your projects could include:

  • Creating a frictionless system for adding new contacts to the CRM.
  • Automatically identifying stale contacts and prompting the appropriate team member to follow up.
  • Scoring prospective clients based on their fit with Nucleus’s ideal customer profile.
  • Enriching new contact and company records using available internal and external data.
  • Suggesting relevant introductions between people in the Nucleus network.
  • Converting meeting transcripts, emails, and notes into structured CRM updates.
  • Building workflows that track introductions and their outcomes.
  • Automating follow-ups after meetings, events, and introductions.
  • Creating internal search or knowledge tools that make information easier to find.
  • Automating repetitive operational tasks across Advisory, Ventures, and Community.
  • Building dashboards that help leadership understand activity, relationships, and performance across the business.

Tools and Technology

Nucleus currently works with tools including:

  • ClickUp
  • Slack
  • Google Workspace
  • DocuSign
  • Superhuman
  • Fathom
  • Wispr Flow
  • Claude

You do not need to have experience with every tool in the current stack. However, you should be comfortable learning new platforms quickly and connecting different systems through native integrations, automation platforms, APIs, or lightweight custom development.

Experience with tools such as Zapier, Make, n8n, Airtable, Retool, Notion, HubSpot, OpenAI, Claude, or similar platforms would be valuable.

What We’re Looking For

  • At least three years of relevant experience in automation, AI implementation, operations, product, business systems, software development, or a related field—or a portfolio that demonstrates equivalent practical ability.
  • Experience building working automations that solve real business problems.
  • Strong practical understanding of generative AI and large language models.
  • Experience using AI tools as part of everyday work, not only for experimentation.
  • Ability to connect applications using APIs, webhooks, native integrations, or automation platforms.
  • Comfort using no-code and low-code platforms.
  • Enough technical fluency to use scripting or lightweight development when necessary.
  • Strong process-mapping and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to understand a business problem before choosing a technical solution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when testing and deploying automated workflows.
  • Ability to manage projects independently and deliver solutions with limited direction.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where requirements may initially be unclear.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or managing CRM systems.
  • Experience with relationship intelligence, lead enrichment, or recommendation systems.
  • Experience working with venture capital, professional services, events, communities, or relationship-driven businesses.
  • Experience developing internal tools or lightweight web applications.
  • Familiarity with databases, structured data, and data-cleaning workflows.
  • Experience with JavaScript, Python, SQL, or similar technologies.
  • Experience managing data privacy, security, access controls, and responsible AI practices.
  • A portfolio, case study, or demonstration of AI-powered workflows you have built.

You’ll Be a Great Fit If You

  • Naturally look for ways to make processes simpler and more efficient.
  • Enjoy turning ambiguous ideas into useful, working systems.
  • Are comfortable experimenting, but care about reliability when moving something into production.
  • Can move between strategic thinking and hands-on implementation.
  • Focus on business outcomes rather than using technology for its own sake.
  • Learn new tools quickly and are not attached to one specific platform.
  • Take ownership of projects and follow through without needing constant direction.
  • Ask thoughtful questions before building.
  • Are excited by the opportunity to shape how an organization uses AI from the ground up.

What Success Could Look Like

During your first few months, you will be expected to:

  • Develop a strong understanding of Nucleus’s business units, systems, and operational processes.
  • Review the existing automation wishlist and recommend priorities.
  • Identify the highest-impact opportunities for AI and automation.
  • Launch initial automations that measurably reduce manual work or improve data quality.
  • Improve the way contacts, relationships, and introductions are captured and tracked.
  • Establish a repeatable process for proposing, building, testing, documenting, and maintaining automations.
  • Create a practical roadmap for future AI implementation across Nucleus.

Longer term, success means that Nucleus operates with better information, fewer manual processes, stronger internal systems, and a thoughtful AI infrastructure that can scale with the business.

Full-Time Philippines

jobs.title: Clinical Trial Manager
jobs.description:
Clinical Trial Manager

Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease.

We are hiring for a Clinical Trial Manager.

Position Summary:

Serves as the clinical trial lead responsible for the planning, conduct and oversight of the operational portion of clinical studies per defined scope of work and ensures that clinical studies are conducted in accordance with the protocol, standard operating procedures (SOPs), ICH-GCP and all applicable regulatory requirements.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Primary clinical point of contact with the client
  • Collaborate with PM on monthly invoicing and variance management of clinical budget
  • Develop study related clinical documents (e.g. clinical plans, Informed Consent Form templates, study specific forms and manuals, CRF completion guidelines, study trackers, PSV/SIV slides and other training materials)
  • Identify and develop training needs for CRAs and third-party vendors specific to the study, protocol and practices including presenting these at Investigator Meetings and Study Kick-off meetings
  • Generate potential site list from key stakeholders and drive site feasibility process
  • Identify potential risks to the enrollment targets based on feasibility analysis and site’s contracted commitment
  • Develop and finalize the country recruitment/retention strategy
  • Develop timely and effective communication and good working relationships with investigators and study team to ensure effective and timely feasibility, site start up, enrollment, maintenance and close out procedures
  • Lead internal clinical team meetings and sets expectations for clinical team of CRAs and CTAs
  • Address all CRA and site questions and maintains Frequently Asked Question (FAQ) log as appropriate
  • Support in planning and conducting investigator meetings
  • Review and/or approve of IP release packages
  • Oversee, support and track all submissions and approvals to Competent Authorities and IRB/Ethics Committees in conjunction with regulatory departments as applicable
  • Develop clinical monitoring strategies for assuring study timelines are met and assuring quality deliverables
  • Generate and utilize metric reporting (e.g. CTMS, DM Query Trends, Outstanding Monitoring Reports) to ensure that the study is conducted per plan and communicates issues to PM and CRAs as appropriate
  • Responsible for eTMF implementation and management
  • Collaborate with PM, CRAs and QA to develop any Corrective and Preventative Action Plan (CAPA) and is accountable for implementation and timely closure
  • Accountable to assist sites, internal staff and CRAs with the preparation for GCP audits
  • Work closely with PM for project-specific resourcing issues
  • Escalate pertinent CRA performance and site compliance issues when necessary
  • Collaborate with data management and CRAs to ensure data quality and compliance with data cleaning timelines
  • Manage processes for investigational product (IP) including drug accountability and reconciliation
  • When a cross-functional PM is not assigned to a given program, the CTM will assume project management responsibility as needed
  • Supports business development and marketing activities as appropriate
  • May negotiate site budget and investigator contract with support from the legal department and/or site contracts group
  • May review site visit reports and ensures monitoring (i.e. scheduling and scope) is executed per monitoring plan
  • May be responsible for management of clinical vendors (e.g. labs, IP, patient diary, home health care) in conjunction with PM
  • May perform clinical data review of patient profiles, data listings and summary tables, including query generation
  • May have line management responsibilities
  • May manages workload of supervised staff with continued assessment and adjustment as needed
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management

Qualifications:

Minimum Required :

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health-related field. Advanced degree preferred
  • Minimum of 5-8 years of clinical research experience or proven competencies for the position with significant clinical monitoring experience. Oncology trial experience preferred.
  • Regional experience required to cover China market

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.

Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com.

Precision Medicine Group will never request payment, banking details, or other sensitive financial information as part of the recruitment process. Company - iwell Germany GmbH - Harmonizing Clean Energy

Standort - Düsseldorf

Über iwell

Bei iwell dreht sich alles um die Stärkung der Energiesicherheit. Wir helfen europäischen Unternehmen, energieunabhängiger zu werden. Angesichts wachsender Regulierung, extremer Preisvolatilität und zunehmender Netzengpässe müssen Unternehmen widerstandsfähig sein. Es ist Zeit, die Initiative zu ergreifen und vorausschauend zu handeln.

Wir liefern Energiemanagementlösungen, die sicherstellen, dass Unternehmen jederzeit die Kontrolle über ihre Energie behalten. Unser hauseigen entwickeltes Energiemanagementsystem (EMS) und modularer Batteriespeicher treiben Profitabilität durch Nachhaltigkeit voran und machen Unternehmen zukunftssicher. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes, internationales Team mutiger, talentierter Menschen – von Ingenieuren und Softwareentwicklern bis hin zu kreativen Köpfen und kundenorientierten Business Developern. Egal, wo deine Stärken liegen: Wir suchen immer Menschen, die entschlossen sind, etwas Positives zu bewirken.

Die Rolle

Als (Senior) Key Account & Sales Manager bist du das Gesicht von iwell auf dem deutschen Markt für unsere gewerblichen, industriellen und Transportkunden. Du verkaufst nicht einfach Standardprodukte, sondern agierst als strategischer Partner für wegweisende Energielösungen – ein starkes, kombiniertes Angebot aus BESS, EMS und O&M-Services.

  • Consultative Selling & Co-Creation: Du verstehst den Kunden und seine Anforderungen genau und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihm eine maßgeschneiderte Lösung aus dem iwell-Produktportfolio. Dabei orchestrierst du Elemente vor Ort wie PV-Anlagen, Ladeinfrastruktur für E-Fahrzeuge und BESS und kommunizierst das EMS-Angebot von iwell klar und verständlich.

  • Business Development & Pipeline-Management: Du identifizierst, akquirierst und entwickelst strategische Schlüsselkunden und Partner im gesamten CCI-Markt (Gewerbekunden, Industriekunden sowie Energiegemeinschaften/Kommunen). Du baust durch Recherche, Networking und gezielte Ansprache eine belastbare Pipeline auf und steuerst den gesamten Vertriebszyklus vom Kaltkontakt bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag – mit Unterstützung unseres internationalen Teams.

  • Beziehungsmanagement: Du agierst als vertrauensvoller Berater auf Augenhöhe – vom Energiemanager in der Schwerindustrie bis zum Entscheider auf C-Level und Installationsunternehmen. Du besuchst Kunden und Partner, präsentierst die Lösungen von iwell und pflegst starke Beziehungen, die Zufriedenheit, Kundenbindung und Weiterempfehlungen fördern.

  • Vertragsabschluss: Du verhandelst Verträge und schließt Deals ab, die sowohl den Unternehmenszielen als auch den Kundenbedürfnissen gerecht werden, und sorgst so für beiderseitige Zufriedenheit.

  • Die Zukunft mitgestalten: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, optimierst unsere Vertriebsstrategie für maßgeschneiderte Lösungen in der DACH-Region – einschließlich Go-to-Market-Ansätzen, etwa für den Transportsektor – und hilfst mit, unsere Prozesse noch intelligenter zu gestalten.

Was wir suchen

  • Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in kaufmännischen und/oder vertriebsnahen Rollen mit.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in mindestens einem der folgenden Bereiche: gewerbliche, industrielle oder elektrifizierte Transportprojekte, Batteriespeichersektor.

  • Du verfügst über ein Netzwerk in relevanten Kundensegmenten wie eMobility, Transportunternehmen mit Lkw und Bussen, Logistikimmobilien, Energieinstallateuren/EPCs und/oder Schwerindustrie mit Elektrifizierungsbedarf.

Was wir bieten

  • Für diese Position bieten wir eine variable Vergütung zusätzlich zu deinem monatlichen Gehalt.

  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, plus einen jährlichen dreitägigen Firmenausflug.

  • Die Möglichkeit, dich ehrenamtlich zu engagieren – wir bieten 1 freiwilligen Tag pro Jahr.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Sales – apeiron (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Werkstudent Sales – apeiron (m/w/d)

Werde Teil des Business Development Teams zur Förderung der neuen, innovativen apeiron-Plattform!

Bei Ginmon arbeiten wir in einem Team aus jungen, visionären Experten daran, die Lücke zwischen wissenschaftlichem Portfoliomanagement und modernster Kapitalmarkttechnologie zu schließen. Mit unserer Plattform helfen wir Privatanleger:innen, ihre finanziellen Ziele durch ETF-basierte Anlagestrategien effizient und kostengünstig zu erreichen. Nach unserem Erfolg im B2C-Bereich markiert das Jahr 2026 einen Meilenstein: den offiziellen Start von apeiron Wealth (www.apeiron-wealth.com). Dabei handelt es sich um unser zukunftsweisendes, KI-natives Betriebssystem für Vermögensberater:innen, das eine hochmoderne, vollautomatisierte Infrastruktur bietet. Diese ermöglicht es Vermögensberater:innen, ihr gesamtes Beratungsgeschäft zu digitalisieren und die Qualität sowie die Tiefe der Kundenbetreuung erheblich zu steigern.

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Sales Team unterstützt du uns bei der Vermarktung des Produkts apeiron und der Generierung neuer Leads. Dabei sammelst du praxisnahe Einblicke in den Aufbau eines wachsenden B2B-Geschäfts.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für unser Produkt apeiron und dessen Marktvorteile, um potenzielle Kund:innen kompetent beraten zu können.

  • Du initiierst den Erstkontakt zu unabhängigen Finanzberater:innen über verschiedene Kanäle (Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn) und vermittelst dabei einen professionellen und positiven Eindruck von apeiron.

  • Du vereinbarst Termine mit unserem Business-Development-Manager und unserem CEO und hilfst mit, unsere Strategie zur Produktvermarktung mitzugestalten.

  • Du pflegst und aktualisierst CRM-Datensätze sorgfältig, um eine datengestützte Sales-Pipeline zu gewährleisten.

  • Du setzt moderne KI-Tools wie Claude und Gemini sowie Prozessautomatisierung ein, um deine Arbeitsprozesse und die Effizienz im Business Development zu steigern.

  • Du arbeitest in einem Team aus jungen, initiativen Menschen und bist dem Business Development Manager sowie dem CEO unterstellt. Dabei erwarten dich Perspektiven zur eigenständigen Übernahme von Aufgaben und Verantwortungsbereichen, die dir helfen, dich zum Business Development Manager weiterzuentwickeln.


Dein Profil

  • Du bist in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, BWL, Finanzen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit Schwerpunkt Kapitalmarkt, eingeschrieben und hast idealerweise noch mindestens ein Jahr Studium vor dir.

  • Du bist kontaktfreudig, kommunikationsstark und trittst auch am Telefon sicher und professionell auf. Idealerweise bringst du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Kundenkontakt, im Vertrieb oder in der Beratung mit.

  • Du begeisterst dich für innovative technologische Lösungen und KI und möchtest Arbeitsprozesse durch intelligente Tools maximal effizient gestalten.

  • Du bist ein echter Teamplayer, kannst aber ebenso eigenständig agieren. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Leads und denkst proaktiv mit.

  • Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (wichtig für die Kundenansprache) und verfügst über verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse.

  • Du wohnst im Rhein-Main-Gebiet und arbeitest flexibel 16 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche in unserem Büro in Frankfurt am Main.

Was wir bieten

  • Die Möglichkeit, den Markterfolg von apeiron Wealth aktiv mitzugestalten und die digitale Transformation der deutschen Vermögensberatung direkt zu beeinflussen.

  • Maßgebliche Möglichkeiten zum Weiterlernen durch Workshops mit erfahrenen Professionals sowie gezielten Kompetenzaufbau.

  • Direktes Reporting an den Business Development Manager und den CEO sowie flache Hierarchien mit viel Raum für deine eigenen Ideen, perfekt, um wertvolle Business- und Vertriebserfahrung direkt vom Management zu sammeln.

  • Ein internationales, junges und gleichgesinntes Team von Profis mit einer ausgeprägten "Get-things-done"-Mentalität und einer hervorragenden Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Eine ausgewogene Balance zwischen Klausurenphase und Job dank flexibler Einteilung deiner 16 bis 20 Stunden.

  • Spezielle Konditionen für Mitarbeiterinvestments, High-End-Equipment (auch für dein Studium nutzbar), regelmäßige Teamevents sowie eine moderne Büroatmosphäre inklusive Kaffeeflatrate, Snacks und Drinks.

jobs.title: Werkstudent – Auftragsabwicklung, Export & Stammdatenmanagement (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Werkstudent – Auftragsabwicklung, Export & Stammdatenmanagement (m/w/d)

Als Werkstudent – Auftragsabwicklung, Export & Stammdatenmanagement (m/w/d) unterstützt du unser Supply Chain- und Export Operations-Team bei der täglichen Auftragsabwicklung, der exportrelevanten Klassifizierung unserer Produkte sowie der Pflege und Verbesserung von Stammdaten.

Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Auftragsabwicklung, Export, Logistik, Produktmanagement und Engineering zusammen und erhältst praxisnahe Einblicke in die operativen Prozesse hinter unseren fortschrittlichen Drohnensystemen.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Du unterstützt unsere Order Processing- und Export Manager im Tagesgeschäft, bei Dokumentationen und bei der Nachverfolgung offener Themen. 

  • Du arbeitest dich in unser Produktportfolio ein und unterstützt bei der exportrelevanten Güterklassifizierung. 

  • Beantragen von Vorgängen beim Bafa über das Portal ElanK2 oder Zollportal (AZG/ vZTA)

  • Du hilfst bei der Erstellung, Pflege und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Stammdaten. 

  • Du sammelst, strukturierst und prüfst produkt-, zoll- und exportrelevante Informationen. 

  • Du unterstützt die Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung von Themen in Tools wie Jira, Confluence und MS Office. 

  • Du identifizierst Unstimmigkeiten in Daten, unterstützt bei der Verbesserung der Datenqualität und bringst dich in Prozessoptimierungen ein.


What you bring to the team:

  • Du studierst aktuell International Commercial Law, Business Law, Wirtschaftsrecht, Internationales Wirtschaftsrecht, Zoll-, Steuer- und Außenwirtschaftsrecht, Master of Customs, Taxation and International Trade Law, Supply Chain Management, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang. 

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kommunizierst sicher, präzise und professionell mit internen Stakeholdern.

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, insbesondere für die Arbeit mit Dokumentationen, Systemen und internationalen Begrifflichkeiten. 

  • Du hast ein schnelles Verständnis für neue Themen und interessierst dich für technische Produkte, operative Prozesse sowie export- und zollrelevante Fragestellungen. 

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und detailorientiert. 

  • Du bist offen, kommunikativ und gehst aktiv auf Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus verschiedenen Fachbereichen zu. 

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel; erste Kenntnisse in Jira, Confluence oder ERP-Systemen sind ein Plus. 

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und fragst gezielt nach, wenn Informationen fehlen.

Why Quantum-Systems:

Wir glauben an die Kraft gemeinsamer Leistungen: fundiertes technisches Know-how, kombiniert mit einem klaren Fokus auf unsere Kunden.

Wir sind Branchenpioniere – ehrgeizig, mutig und visionär.

Wir verschieben Grenzen, denken über den Tellerrand hinaus und streben nach technologischer Exzellenz, um die Zukunft der luftgestützten Daten zu gestalten.

Wir bieten dir die perfekte Grundlage für deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung.

Our benefits:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Mit unserem Vertrauensarbeitszeitmodell gestaltest du nicht nur deine Arbeitszeit flexibel, sondern auch deine Work-Life-Balance.

  • Mobiles Arbeiten: Wenn es im Büro mal etwas turbulenter wird, kannst du durch mobiles Arbeiten für den nötigen Ausgleich sorgen.

  • Bleib aktiv: Mit dem EGYM Wellpass erhältst du Zugang zu tausenden Fitness- und Sportangeboten – und wir bezuschussen deine Mitgliedschaft.

  • Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von attraktiven Angeboten und Rabatten bei bekannten Marken und Anbietern wie Adidas, Apple oder Expedia.

  • Mitarbeiterevents: Wir wollen nicht nur gemeinsam wachsen, sondern auch unsere Erfolge gemeinsam feiern.

  • Lunch Card: Für deine tägliche Stärkung stellen wir dir ein bezuschusstes Lunch-Budget zur Verfügung.

  • Company Shuttle: Nutze unseren komfortablen Shuttle-Service, der dich von Laim in München abholt und nach Feierabend wieder zurückbringt.

About us:

Quantum Systems ist auf die Entwicklung, Konstruktion und Produktion kleiner unbemannter Luftfahrtsysteme (sUAS) spezialisiert.

Das Portfolio des Unternehmens umfasst elektrisch betriebene senkrecht startende und landende (eVTOL) sUAS, die darauf ausgelegt sind, maximale Reichweite und Vielseitigkeit zu bieten und den Anwender:innen ein nahtloses Nutzungserlebnis zu ermöglichen.

Durch die Integration modernster Softwarelösungen wie Edge Computing und KI-gestützter Echtzeit-Datenverarbeitung entwickelt Quantum Systems die nächste Generation von UAS für Kund:innen in den Bereichen Verteidigung, Sicherheit und öffentlicher Sektor.

Sources

Our commitment:

Wir sind ein aufgeschlossenes Unternehmen, das Vielfalt nicht nur wertschätzt, sondern aktiv fördert. Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung sind wir fest davon überzeugt, dass die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeitenden ein wesentlicher Bestandteil unseres Erfolgs ist.

jobs.title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Data Scientist (m/f/d)

Shape the Future of Data-Driven Decision Making as our Data Scientist (m/f/d)

At Limehome, data is one of our biggest competitive advantages. As a Data Scientist, you'll turn complex business challenges into scalable statistical and machine learning solutions that help us make smarter decisions across pricing, operations, product, and beyond.

Working closely with Revenue Management, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, and other stakeholders, you'll combine advanced statistical thinking with commercial acumen to create measurable business impact while continuously raising the bar for data-driven decision-making.

How you’ll be hosting with heart:

  • Design, develop, and continuously improve our core pricing algorithms—our highest-impact analytical products—to maximize revenue, occupancy, and long-term profitability.

  • Design, develop, and evaluate advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms to solve complex business challenges and enable smarter decision-making.

  • Apply rigorous statistical methodologies to quantify uncertainty, estimate business impact, and generate reliable recommendations for decision-making.

  • Design experiments and define evaluation frameworks to measure the effectiveness of new products, pricing strategies, and business initiatives.

  • Analyze large and complex datasets to uncover opportunities for growth, operational improvements, and enhanced customer experience.

  • Partner with Revenue Management, Product, Engineering, and BI to translate business questions into scalable analytical solutions and collaborate with Data Engineering to productionize, deploy, and monitor machine learning models.

  • Stay at the forefront of AI, ML, and decision science to elevate our analytical capabilities, while clearly communicating complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.


What you need to shoot for the stars:

  • Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field combined with 3+ years of hands-on experience applying machine learning/statistics to real-world business problems.

  • Strong foundation in probability theory, statistical inference, regression analysis, Bayesian statistics, experimentation, causal inference, and predictive modelling.

  • Proven experience developing, validating, and improving machine learning models in business environments.

  • Strong programming and modelling skills in Python and experience with modern data science libraries. Excellent SQL skills and experience working with large analytical datasets.

  • Experience designing experiments and evaluating business initiatives, balancing statistical rigor with pragmatic decision-making to deliver simple, high-value solutions over unnecessary complexity.

  • Strong commercial mindset with a passion for exploring new analytical methods/AI tech and translating complex findings into measurable business recommendations.

  • Fluency in English with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills alongside the ability to explain complex concepts to audiences with varying technical backgrounds.

We're designed to stay because:

  • Hybrid Office Model: We offer a flexible and empowering work environment - you can choose to work 100% from our office or partially from home and the office.

  • Visa & Language Support: We’ll support you during your visa process and with learning German on every language level after passing your probation period.

  • Relocation Support: We'll financially support your move to Munich if you live further away than 300km from our office.

  • Oneteam: We are #oneteam with a transparent company culture by staying up to date with each other through team stand-ups, regular All-Hands and suite events (Summer, Wiesn, Christmas).

  • Growth and Development: We make sure that you keep growing - through constant feedback, peer reviews and exchanges with focus on your development.

  • Limitless learning: We offer you the possibility to choose an external development format that will help you in reaching your full potential without any limits in budget.

  • Workation: You have the chance to work twice per year for a duration of up to 4 weeks from a different country in the European Union. Our Limehomies love traveling so we want to give them the chance to work from inspiring new locations regularly.

  • Sabbatical: After your 1.5 years with Limehome we offer the possibility for a 3-month sabbatical. You can use it for whatever you want: may it be traveling, spending time with your besties or volunteering.

  • Everything for our Limehomies: We focus on your physical wellbeing (Urban Sports Club), to your mental wellbeing (Nilo.health), or even staycations in one of our beautiful Limehomes, and many more suite benefits. Join us and find out! 😉

Who we are:

Limehome is a leading tech-enabled operator in the hospitality industry offering functional, design accommodations across Europe. Using proprietary technology, Limehome delivers comfortable and convenient stays with a seamless digital guest experience for business and leisure travellers. Our vision is to be the first choice in travel for everyone, everywhere. By now, our portfolio consists of more than 10,000 apartments and hotel rooms under contract across 150 cities in 13 European countries.
