jobs.title: Director of Quality
jobs.description:
Director of Quality

About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Location: Remote or hybrid, EMEA or US Eastern time zone

Team: Production, Quality

Reports to: VP Production

Direct reports: Quality Manager (AMER, customer staffing) and 2 Quality Coordinators

About the role

As Director of Quality, you will own LILT's quality system end to end: standards, audit, compliance, procedures, continuous improvement, and the roadmap and operation of our Quality Agents. You'll help move Quality from a primarily reactive, execution-led function to a proactive, data-driven partner for customers and internal teams, with quality designed into our AI-native workflows.

You'll be the person who can run a customer audit while simultaneously shipping an improved agent evaluation. As the single Quality partner for Customer Success, Production, Research and Product, you'll turn customer requirements into measurable acceptance criteria, effective controls and better models and workflows. You'll advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix, including where automated, agent-verified and human-verified workflows are appropriate, with stronger assurance for high-risk and regulated content.

We're looking for a hands-on Quality SME and operator with real depth in both worlds: experience designing and building AI agents and improving LLM output, and a solid grounding in traditional quality management. You'll bring senior expertise in data, AI, customer advisory and process, and make sure quality work prevents recurrence rather than stopping at rework or ticket closure.

What you'll do

Quality Agent leadership

  • Evaluate, design and build reliable Quality Agents with well-defined tools and clear, structured instructions.

  • Use orchestration patterns to evolve from a single agent to multi-agent systems.

  • Define evaluation criteria, test sets and success metrics for agent performance, and run agents in production with clear monitoring and escalation paths.

  • Drive adoption across teams and show measurable reductions in manual quality effort.

Research and Product partnership

  • Work closely with Research and Product on ADQ, LLM model improvements, AI Review, AI QA, and new and emerging AI workflows.

  • Turn quality findings into product requirements, evaluation criteria and continuous feedback loops that improve model and workflow output.

  • Act as the voice of quality in roadmap discussions, and help decide where human review, AI review or both are needed.

Audit, compliance and procedure

  • Own LILT's approach to internal and external audits, including ISO certification (e.g. ISO 17100, ISO 18587, ISO 9001) and customer audits.

  • Plan and run periodic internal audits, manage evidence collection, and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.

  • Standardise and maintain SOPs, workflows and quality documentation, and keep them current as AI workflows change how we work.

  • Make sure quality processes meet customer, contractual and regulatory requirements.

Customer advisory

  • Partner with Customer Success and Delivery to define proactive quality programmes, success metrics and governance for strategic accounts, including AI-forward enterprise and life science / regulatory programmes.

  • Translate customer quality requirements into clear pre-delivery acceptance criteria, validation methods and risk-appropriate controls.

  • Advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix and where automated, agent-verified, human-verified or combined workflows are appropriate.

  • Represent LILT's quality function as a credible subject-matter authority in customer business reviews, audits and escalations, using quality data and metrics to demonstrate fitness for purpose.

Continuous improvement

  • Lead structured CI across the Commercial business: root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, KPI reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own a proactive quality metrics framework that makes errors, PQs, rework and trends visible, and use it to prioritise improvements and demonstrate outcomes.

  • Strengthen quality controls across review, delivery and follow-through, including mandatory account-specific checks, intervention on critical findings and clear escalation ownership.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to automate checks and escalation, and verify that corrective actions prevent recurrence rather than ending at rework or ticket closure.

Expert Operations partnership

  • Partner with Expert Supply and Ops to embed processes, guidance and quality feedback that maintain a high-quality pipeline of experts.

  • Use quality findings and recurring failure patterns to improve expert qualification, guidance and ongoing quality management.

Team leadership

  • Lead and develop the Quality team, including the customer-facing Quality Manager and Quality Coordinators.

  • Establish the team's operating cadence and evolve how the team works as Quality Agents reduce manual coordination work.

  • Oversee embedded Quality Manager staffing sold as a service to customers, ensuring the role owns the specific quality programmes and initiatives those customers pay for.

  • Develop playbooks for AI-driven quality management and keep staffing-as-a-service delivery aligned with LILT's quality standards.

What you'll bring

Must have

  • Agent design and build: demonstrable, hands-on experience designing, building and running LLM-based agents in production. Please be ready to walk us through agents you have built.

  • Data-driven quality management: scripting or data skills (e.g. Python, SQL), with experience turning quality data into actionable metrics, preventive controls and measurable improvements.

  • LLM model improvement: proven experience improving LLM output quality.

  • Significant experience running quality systems, including leading audits (internal and external), compliance programmes, and writing and maintaining processes and procedures. Quality certifications such as Six Sigma are a plus.

  • Experience leading structured CI (RCA, CAPA, KPI reviews).

  • Experience managing and developing people.

  • Customer advisory and cross-functional partnership: a clear communicator who can translate customer quality requirements into acceptance criteria and governance, advise on quality, cost and speed trade-offs, and work credibly with customers, executives and technical teams.

Nice to have

  • Background in localisation, translation or language services.

  • Experience in customer-facing quality roles for enterprise accounts.

  • Research and Product collaboration: a track record of working with research scientists and product managers to turn quality insight into product requirements and shipped improvements.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

jobs.description:
Lead Architect - Digital Assets

We are hiring on behalf of our client, an established, leading European regulated financial institution who is expanding its digital assets capabilities to build the next generation of financial market infrastructure. The organization is seeking a Lead Architect – Digital Assets to lead a zero-to-one build, bridging traditional capital markets with decentralised finance (DeFi).

This mandate involves architecting the core platform behind initial tokenised offerings across two major live initiatives currently in design:

  1. Tokenised Issuance, Trading, and Settlement Platform: Supporting equities, ETFs, and bonds with a 24/7 central limit order book, fractional trading, CCP-cleared trades, and end-of-day atomic DvP settlement on-chain.
  2. Tokenised Collateral-Management Platform: Designed for sovereign bonds to enable real-time repo, CCP-margin eligibility, and DeFi distribution of government securities through gated lending venues.

The architecture is built on core principles: the token serves as the direct financial instrument, one ISIN corresponds to one ledger, and tokenisation is driven directly by the CSD. The Lead Architect will turn these principles into a concrete, secure, resilient, and auditable infrastructure.

Requirements

  • Architecture & System Design: Own the end-to-end architecture for digital asset solutions, seamlessly integrating distributed ledger technology (DLT) with traditional market infrastructure (trading, clearing, settlement, custody, and CSD).
  • Cross-Chain & Network Topology: Design cross-chain topology combining permissioned chains for institutional and CCP operations (e.g., Hyperledger Besu, Canton Network) with public chains for DeFi distribution (Ethereum / L2).
  • On-Chain Compliance & Governance: Define regulatory compliance frameworks on-chain, utilizing regulated security-token standards (ERC-3643 / T-REX), KYC-whitelisted wallets, automated transfer restrictions, real-time AML screening (Chainalysis / Elliptic), and transaction reporting under MiFIR.
  • Custody & Key Management: Architect robust custody models around MPC solutions (e.g., Fireblocks, Taurus), incorporating hybrid frameworks to support bring-your-own-custody (BYOC) for institutional clients.

jobs.title: Junior Product Designer - UI/UX
jobs.description:
Junior Product Designer - UI/UX

You turn complex manufacturing data into interfaces factory teams rely on every day, working side by side with our engineers.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We are a fast-growing team driving massive impact in one of the largest and most under-served industries in the world.

We serve the world's top manufacturers across the globe. From Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, our customers trust us to make their factories run better. We are backed by leading investors like Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Google, Meta, Palantir, MBB, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You’ll join our small design team and work directly with our engineers. At first you’ll focus on UI: building screens, components and flows for our platform, and helping our design system grow. Over time you’ll take on larger parts of the product end to end.

This is what you’ll do:

  • Turn flows and concepts into detailed production-ready screens.

  • Create and maintain components in Figma, keep them in sync with what’s in code, and notice when patterns start to drift.

  • Pair with developers, review builds, and make quick trade-offs when something doesn’t fit the sprint. Your designs ship; you don’t just hand off Figma files.

  • When a shortcut hurts the experience, you say so, explain why, and propose an alternative. And you know when good enough is good enough.

  • Join customer calls and factory visits, test ideas with our forward deployed engineers, and bring what you learn back into the product.

  • Help where a startup needs it: website updates, sales decks and marketing visuals now and then.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

First and foremost, we believe in curious people who are eager to learn and grow. If you're passionate about cutting-edge tech and driving major impact in manufacturing, we want to hear from you.

You don’t need to have done it all. We can teach you manufacturing, our product, and a lot about designing complex B2B software. We can’t teach you to care about the details, or to be curious about how things work.

Must-haves:

  • You’re fluent in English and comfortable with changing priorities. You know when to be scrappy and when to be thorough.

  • You have 1–3 years of professional experience designing digital products. Internships and working-student roles count if you shipped real work.

  • You have strong UI craft and have hands-on experience with a design system.

  • You’re fluent in Figma (components, variants, auto layout, variables) and comfortable using AI tools for quick iterations and prototypes.

  • You enjoy working closely with developers and understand enough about frontend to design things that can be built.

  • You can explain and stand behind your design decisions, and you change your mind when someone has a better argument.

  • You’re curious about users, technology and how things get made, and you actively look for feedback so you can grow.

Bonus:

  • Experience with B2B SaaS, dashboards or data-heavy products

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person.

You’ll work alongside two senior designers, get regular design critiques, and sit close to the engineers who build what you design. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Performance-based career & growth paths

  • On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

  • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

  • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

  • Flexible parental leave

  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.

HOW TO APPLY

Send us your CV and a portfolio with 2–3 case studies, at least one showing detailed UI work. Tell us briefly what you did yourself and what the team did.

Our interview process includes a short design challenge during the on-site, so you can show us how you work.

Join Our Team as a Project Manager at Beyond Sports

If you’re someone who thrives on bringing people, technology, and clients together, enjoys taking ownership of projects from start to finish, and gets energy from delivering high-quality digital products, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

At Beyond Sports, you’ll work on innovative consumer-facing products and experiences within the sports world, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to turn ideas and client requirements into successful deliveries.

What Your Day Will Look Like

As a Project Manager within the Beyond Sports Delivery Team, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of consumer-facing software projects, including websites, mobile applications, data visualizations, and other digital sports experiences.

You’ll take ownership of scoping, planning, budgeting, and project delivery, while making sure projects stay on track and meet the quality our clients and users expect. You’ll work closely with our Design, Engineering, and QA teams, facilitating collaboration and ensuring everyone has the clarity they need to deliver successfully.

You’ll also be a key point of contact for our external clients. From translating customer requirements and feedback into clear scopes, functional requirements, and user stories to managing expectations, risks, and project progress, you’ll make sure communication stays clear throughout the entire project lifecycle.

When our products go live, you’ll be there too, acting as a central point of communication and helping coordinate and escalate where necessary during live events.

What We Value

At Beyond Sports, we value people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable working in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

As a Project Manager, you’ll need to be proactive and organised, while also being able to adapt your approach depending on the project, client, and team you’re working with. You should be comfortable managing several projects at once and confident bringing together different perspectives to keep everyone moving towards the same goal.

We’re looking for someone who understands the world of technology and software development and can comfortably translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience working with data-driven products or projects is particularly valuable for this role.

While this role is based in Alkmaar, Netherlands, we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, so we expect you to be available for 32–40 hours per week in the office.

Skills and Experience

You don’t need to tick every box, but here’s what we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience managing software or digital projects from start to finish, ideally including consumer-facing products such as websites, mobile applications, or data visualization products

  • Experience with project scoping, planning, budgeting, and resource coordination

  • Strong understanding of software development processes and working with multidisciplinary teams across Design, Engineering, and QA

  • Experience translating customer requirements and feedback into clear scopes, functional requirements, and user stories

  • Strong client and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to act as the main point of contact throughout project delivery

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience managing project risks, issues, reporting, documentation, and delivery progress

  • The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and attention to detail

  • A proactive and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving

  • Strong collaboration and facilitation skills, with the ability to bring teams and stakeholders together around decisions

  • The confidence to negotiate, manage expectations, and resolve conflicts professionally when needed

  • Experience working with project management and delivery tools such as Azure DevOps and Jira

  • Familiarity with modern AI tools such as Copilot and Claude

  • A good understanding of data or data-driven products is strongly preferred

Nice to have:

  • Experience with tools such as Figma and Trello

  • Experience working within the sports, media, broadcast, or technology industry

  • Experience supporting the delivery of live products or events

  • Experience identifying and implementing improvements to delivery processes and ways of working

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you’re ready to take ownership of exciting digital projects, work directly with clients, and bring together talented multidisciplinary teams to deliver innovative sports experiences, we’d love to hear from you.

At Beyond Sports, you won’t just be managing timelines and budgets. You’ll play an important role in turning ideas, technology, and sports data into experiences that reach fans around the world.

  • Ownership and responsibility: Take projects from initial scope and planning all the way through to successful delivery.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Design, Engineering, QA, Business Development, and external clients.

  • Innovation: Be part of a company building new ways for fans and clients to experience sports.

We also offer:

  • Fresh fruit, coffee, and Friday drinks – Fuel and fun throughout the week

If you're ready to level up your career, apply now and help us deliver the future of sports tech!

Manager, Customer Support

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients.

We're looking for a Manager, Customer Support to lead a high-performing team of Support Specialists and Support Engineers. This isn't traditional support management—you'll treat support as a product, using data to diagnose friction, design experiments to improve resolution speed and quality, and continuously optimize the system that delivers customer outcomes.

You'll be the operational leader for Elation's support experience, owning team performance, development, and the daily execution of SLA commitments. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Operations to translate support insights into product improvements, and build the analytics infrastructure that makes support performance transparent and actionable.

If you think like a Product Manager, love operations, and want to build a technically oriented team that drives real impact, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do

Lead a High-Performing Team

  • Manage approximately 8–10 Support Specialists and Support Engineers, owning hiring, onboarding, development, performance management, and retention
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s focused on skill development, case quality review, and career growth
  • Coach your team to critically evaluate AI-generated recommendations and deliver exceptional customer outcomes—quality over speed
  • Hold your team accountable to SLA commitments, including time-to-resolution, backlog targets, and customer satisfaction scores

Own Support Operations & Processes

  • Manage the daily execution of case triage, routing, and escalation workflows to ensure efficient resolution
  • Monitor case queue health in real time and identify bottlenecks or quality issues before they impact customers
  • Design and run experiments to improve case resolution speed, first-contact resolution rates, and customer satisfaction
  • Build and maintain the Support playbook, including documentation, troubleshooting guides, and AI-assisted workflow standards
  • Own the QA process for AI-assisted case resolution; audit quality regularly and coach to gaps

Drive Data-Driven Insights

  • Treat metrics as your product: build dashboards, define KPIs, and make support performance visible and actionable
  • Run weekly case reviews with your team to identify patterns, high-volume issue types, and systemic product gaps
  • Translate case data into prioritized feedback for Product and Engineering teams
  • Own monthly reporting on team performance, SLA trends, top case drivers, and escalation patterns
  • Use data to forecast capacity needs, identify skill gaps, and recommend training investments

Partner Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with Engineering Managers to keep support context present in product decisions
  • Collaborate with Customer Operations on service standards and cross-functional initiatives
  • Surface urgent product issues and provide context for prioritization decisions
  • Build feedback loops to ensure case-driving issues get resolved upstream

Improve Systems Continuously

  • Proactively identify inefficiencies in support workflows, tooling, or documentation and drive improvements
  • Recommend and implement automation that increases team leverage (e.g., AI response quality, case routing logic, knowledge base search)

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

  • Build trust with your team through 1:1s, understanding strengths and challenges, and establishing clear expectations
  • Master the case data: know the top case drivers, current SLA performance, and team capacity model
  • Establish effective partnerships with Engineering Managers
  • Identify and fix 1–2 quick-win process inefficiencies

First Year

  • SLA performance: Your team consistently meets time-to-resolution targets and keeps backlog under control
  • Case quality: AI-assisted case resolution accuracy at 95%+; zero critical escalations due to poor case handling
  • Team development: At least one team member promoted or developing toward the next level; retention at 90%+
  • Product impact: Your case data analysis drives 3+ roadmap prioritization decisions that reduce case volume
  • Operational leverage: You've built analytics dashboards, improved documentation, and implemented at least one automation that increases team impact by 10%+

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 5+ years in technical support, customer success operations, or technical account management, with at least 2 years managing people
  • Proven track record managing to SLAs in a technical support or customer operations environment
  • Experience with technical products (SaaS, B2B software, healthcare tech preferred) where support requires genuine technical troubleshooting, not just scripted responses
  • Data fluency: You've built dashboards, analyzed trends, and used metrics to drive operational improvements—not just reported them

Skills & Attributes

  • Systems thinker: You see support as a process to optimize, not just a queue to clear; you've redesigned workflows or implemented tooling that improved efficiency
  • Product management mindset: You understand root cause analysis and think about preventing issues upstream rather than just resolving them faster
  • Technical credibility: You can learn product architecture, understand complex workflows, and coach support engineers on technical cases
  • Coaching-oriented: You develop people through feedback, skill-building, and stretch opportunities—not just task assignment
  • High standards with empathy: You hold your team accountable while supporting their growth
  • Cross-functional collaboration: You've worked effectively with Engineering, Product, or Customer Success teams where success required partnership
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: You're excited to build operations for a new support model without a perfect playbook on day one

Nice to Have

  • Experience in healthcare, health tech, or regulated industries
  • Exposure to AI-assisted support workflows or LLM-based tooling
  • Prior experience as a technical support engineer or individual contributor before moving into management
  • Familiarity with Notion, Linear, Salesforce, Intercom, or similar support/case management platforms

Salary range: $110,000-140,000 CAD

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

Full-Time Canada

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist - Tier 1 - US Remote
jobs.description:
Technical Support Specialist - Tier 1 - US Remote

What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

Position Overview

When a nurse can't reach the right physician at 2am, or a critical alert isn't routing where it should, our Support Specialists are the ones who fix it. Join PerfectServe's 24/7/365 support team and help keep clinical communication running for the hospitals, physicians, and care teams who depend on it.

The Role

As a Support Specialist, you'll support and troubleshoot for PerfectServe's end users, physicians, nurses, and system administrators. Day to day, that means user account management, end-user education, on-call schedule management, mobile and web application support, and hands-on troubleshooting.

Compensation and Schedule

  • $19/hour to start + shift differential for nights/weekends, plus a comprehensive benefits package effective on day one
  • Most schedules include one weekend day and some holiday coverage
  • We're currently hiring for both day and night shifts
  • Fully remote within the United States
  • Able to start by November 16, 2026

Training

New hires onboard and train together on a Monday through Friday, daytime (EST) schedule, with mentorship before moving to your permanent shift. We expect 100% attendance during your first 60 days, this nesting period is what sets you up to succeed once you're on your own.

What You’re Bringing

  • A dedicated, distraction-free home workspace with hardwired or verified reliable high-speed internet, this is a remote, mission-critical support role, so a stable setup matters from day one
  • A track record of troubleshooting through complex issues methodically, be ready to walk us through a real example: what broke, how you worked the problem, and how you resolved it
  • Experience supporting customers across multiple channels, phone, chat, and ticketing systems, and comfort managing escalations across all three
  • A pattern of growth in past roles: taking on more responsibility, training others, or earning a promotion, rather than a string of short, similar stints
  • Real interest in what PerfectServe does and why healthcare communication matters to you, we'd rather hear that than "the schedule works for me"
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • High customer empathy and a genuine drive to help people
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities
  • Willingness to work evenings, overnights, and/or weekends

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Field incoming client communications via phone, chat, and our online customer portal
  • Help end-users administer their PerfectServe applications and train them on our phone, mobile, and web tools
  • Troubleshoot message delivery and content issues, from root-cause diagnosis through configuration fixes
  • Build and revise user accounts based on established standards
  • Partner with hospital IT teams to resolve mobile and web connectivity issues
  • Consult on and configure custom application builds to fit end-user workflows
  • Collaborate with customer success, integration, and technical teams on escalated issues

Our Team, Our Culture

We're a distributed team, and we keep cameras on for internal and external meetings, it's a small thing that keeps us connected and engaged even when we're not in the same room.

About PerfectServe

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

Environment, Physical & Other Requirements

This position requires interaction with people and technology while either standing or sitting. In order to best service our customers on the phone, face-to-face, or on the computer, all employees must be able to communicate with or without reasonable accommodation. Depending on the assignment, may require ordinary ambulatory skills sufficient to visit other locations; or the ability to stand, walk and manipulate (lift, carry, move) light to medium weights of 10 - 50 pounds. Requires good hand-eye coordination, arm, hand and finger dexterity, including ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard, operate equipment and read technical information.

PerfectServe is committed to compliance with its obligations under all applicable state and federal laws prohibiting employment discrimination. In keeping with this commitment, it attempts to reasonably accommodate applicants and employees in accordance with the requirements of the disability discrimination laws. It also invites individuals with disabilities to participate in a good faith, interactive process to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made without imposing an undue hardship.

This position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. PerfectServe, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer -----M/F/D/V.

Why Join PerfectServe?

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.
We offer a compensation range at $19.00 USD / hour, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team. The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support.We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations.

Benefits:

  • Remote first work environment
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.
  • 401K - with match and immediately vested.
  • 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy
  • Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

jobs.title: Catalog & Content Lead
jobs.description:
Catalog & Content Lead

About the job

Fresh Prints is about to go through the biggest catalog shift in company history. We've always sold custom apparel to groups - chapters, teams, clubs. That's changing: we're building a catalog where every product and design has its own shoppable page, so anyone can browse and buy directly, the way you'd shop at any other ecommerce store. Over the next year, our catalog will grow roughly 100x, from a few hundred listings to tens of thousands of individual product pages.

Someone has to build what makes that catalog possible: the publishing pipeline, the QA process, and a team of three that can run it well without you standing over their shoulder. This isn't a maintenance job. Nobody here has run a catalog at this scale before, so a lot of what you build in the first few months won't have a template to follow — you'd be building the foundation for a 100x scale-up from close to day one, and a year from now, you'll have a genuinely rare story to tell about what you built and when.

We're looking for someone who can lead a small team, own a production calendar, and hold a real quality bar under pressure, who also happens to be technical enough to get hands-on with a CMS when something needs fixing. If building the system behind a company's next stage of growth sounds like the kind of problem you want to solve, please apply.

You'll own our product catalog, our QA process, and the team of three that grows with it. Build the systems now, and a year from now your team is running most of it without you, while you're already onto the next big problem.

What You'll Own

Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Manage and mentor a team of three, setting clear expectations for quality, pace, and ownership
  • Delegate real ownership to your team rather than staying the single point of failure for every workflow
  • Know the difference between a capacity problem, a process problem, and a performance problem, and address each the right way

Project & Production Management

  • Own the production calendar across launches, campaigns, catalog updates, and ad hoc requests
  • Turn incoming requests into scope, owners, deadlines, and QA checkpoints
  • Forecast your team's capacity, flag conflicts before a deadline is at risk, and negotiate scope when priorities collide instead of letting the team silently absorb an impossible workload

Asset & Catalog Quality

  • Own product publishing across every product line, with accurate metadata and imagery before anything goes live
  • Design and scale the QA process that catches errors before they reach the live site as the catalog grows toward tens of thousands of listings
  • Document workflows clearly enough that the team doesn't depend on any one person's memory

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Be the one who keeps product work moving across departments on schedule, with risk flagged early and a clear path forward whenever something's blocked

Who You Are

  • You love building systems. You can turn an ad hoc process into something documented and repeatable that the whole team can run.
  • You're scrappy under pressure. You'll sketch out a tracker on the spot or jump into the work yourself rather than let something slip while you wait for the perfect tool.
  • You understand product data at a deep level — comfortable enough inside a CMS to know when a field is derived from somewhere else, and enough of a craft eye to know what's actually wrong with an asset.
  • You can hold five moving projects and competing deadlines in your head at once without one quietly slipping through the cracks.
  • You're direct. When a teammate is falling short, you say so the same day, not weeks later. When you're the one falling behind, you say that too.
  • You're curious about where the catalog is breaking. You'll notice the colorway that's slightly off before a customer ever does.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of relevant experience
  • Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Prior experience leading or co-leading a team, with genuine ownership of people and their output
  • A track record of managing projects against hard deadlines with multiple contributors
  • A track record of building or scaling a QA process for content or product output at high volume
  • Hands-on fluency with a content management system (CMS) or product information management (PIM) platform. You understand the underlying data structure, not just the interface
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop (Illustrator is a plus)

Strong differentiator, not required: scripted or automated production workflows in Photoshop, or comfort building lightweight tools using AI, no-code platforms, or basic scripting.

Compensation

  • Between $900 - $1,000 (adjusted for experience), with $40 night shift allowance

Working Hours:

  • 3 PM - 12 AM Philippine Time.

Location:

  • Work from Home/Remote

At Fresh Prints, we deeply value the long-term contributions of our team. To recognize and celebrate that commitment, we offer a 2-month paid Sabbatical to eligible employees.

Fresh Prints is an equal employment opportunity employer and promotes diversity, actively encouraging people of all backgrounds, ages, LGBTQ+, and those with disabilities to apply.

Full-Time Philippines

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer, APAC
jobs.description:
Technical Support Engineer, APAC

About Us

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets to see for yourself!)

Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $125M in funding from top angels, operators, and security leaders.

About the Role

We're looking for a Technical Support Engineer to join as Socket's dedicated support hire in APAC, based in Australia. You'll be the go-to person for developers and security teams across Zendesk, Slack, and Discord, working to resolve the majority of issues independently. Day to day, that looks like troubleshooting technical issues, guiding customers through Socket's products, and building out the docs and resources that reduce repeat questions. You'll jump on video calls with enterprise customers when needed and flag patterns that shape our product roadmap. The runbooks you write, the macros you build, and the patterns you spot will shape how Socket scales support going forward.

This role works 8am to 5pm within your time zone in Australia, with some overlap with other global time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Own inbound support tickets during APAC hours from first response through resolution, meeting SLA targets independently.

  • Dig into integration issues across Socket's GitHub App, CLI, API, and CI/CD pipeline checks by reading logs, tracing webhook failures, inspecting JSON payloads, and reproducing edge cases.

  • When something needs to go to Engineering, send it with everything they need: repro steps, scan output, environment details, and your best hypothesis.

  • Understand package ecosystems well enough to explain scan results, manifest files, lockfile behaviors, and flagged risks to both developers and security stakeholders.

  • Build out support resources including runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and Zendesk macros for common issues.

  • Spot patterns in tickets and bring recurring issues and undocumented edge cases back to the Customer Engineering and Product teams.

  • Keep the broader team in the loop with clear, thorough handoffs.

  • Must be located in Australia

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years in technical support, support engineering, or TAM at a B2B SaaS company,

  • Supported developer-facing products with API/integration complexity, or have strong linux system administration and troubleshooting experience.

  • Comfortable in a terminal and with code. Reading a JSON payload, parsing a stack trace, understanding what a lockfile does, and writing or tweaking a basic Python or JavaScript script should all feel familiar.

  • A solid grasp of developer workflows. You know what a CI/CD pipeline does, how build processes work, and what it means when a dependency gets flagged.

  • Some familiarity with the security or DevSecOps space is a plus. SCA tools, CVEs, SBOM, supply chain risk. You do not need to be a security researcher, but caring about the problem goes a long way.

  • Clear, concise written English. Most communication here happens async and in writing, so getting your point across cleanly matters.

  • A habit of writing things down. When you solve something, your instinct is to document it so the next person does not have to start from scratch.

  • Experience with Zendesk or a similar ticketing tool is a plus, as is exposure to open source ecosystems (npm, PyPI, Maven) or CI tooling like GitHub Actions or CircleCI.

  • Ability to work 8am - 5pm within your time zone in Australia, Monday through Friday; plus availability for rotational on-call support for weekend/holiday rotation.

Our Interview Process

  1. Informational with a member from our Talent Team

  2. Virtual f2f with the Hiring Manager

  3. Technical Interviews

  4. Presentation phase

  5. Final call with our Founder

  6. References

  7. Decision/Offer

Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy and how we approach the process at Socket.

Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

  • Market competitive salary bands

  • Meaningful equity program

  • Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

  • Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

  • Paid parental leave

  • Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites

At Socket, we

  1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

  2. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

  3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

  4. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.

  5. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.

  6. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.

Full-Time Australia

Senior Software Engineer - SRE

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer - SRE

Location:Mexico, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in Mexico. Candidates must be based in Mexico and be able to travel to the office in Guadalajara as needed.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our Senior Software Engineer will be pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing team in Mexico. We are looking for experienced Senior Software Engineers who can help realize Salesloft's vision with their passion and proven track record of excellence and innovation. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about their work and who thrive working on leading-edge cloud-based technologies to develop ground-breaking AI-driven enterprise-grade applications.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible to -

  • Design and implement solutions to improve availability and resiliency of Salesloft's services
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure and containerized environments using Terraform and Kubernetes, while developing automated CI/CD pipelines to streamline application delivery and infrastructure deployments.
  • Improve operational maturity by defining and implementing SLIs, SLOs, enable faster detection, and isolation of failures and proactively work to mitigate them
  • Collaborate on sustainable incident response, retrospectives, and identifying opportunities to improve user experience

You will be responsible for building and managing critical third-party services in our software stack, influencing system design, building fault tolerance and disaster recovery capabilities, optimizing systems to improve efficiency. You will participate in implementation of integrating these services to solve large-scale problems, and ensure problem-free, reliable and efficient functioning of these components.

Our teams are empowered and expected to help realize Salesloft's vision via active development and collaboration with our engineering partners.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to work on an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking Senior Software Engineer who would be Working on cutting-edge technologies alongside a highly motivated and skilled team eager to learn and grow together

If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Software Engineer is the career path for you!

THE TEAM:

Salesloft's Infrastructure team builds systems and tools to enable engineering velocity in a reliable manner, partnering with engineering teams to establish standards, improve reliability, and increase cost-efficiency.

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.

This is a great opportunity to make a massive impact on scaling cloud infrastructure to meet the high demand and rapid growth of both users and workload per user. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to define and design solutions that meet our business needs for availability, performance, and reliability.

THE SKILL SET:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience building distributed systems on a public cloud (AWS, GCP)
  • Proven DevOps & Cloud experience using Terraform | Kubernetes | CI/CD | Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Certifications: CKA or CKS (preferred)
  • Foundation in software application design and system internals
  • Collaborate effectively with other engineers to solve most complex technical problems. This involves mentoring, peer reviews, participating in technical design reviews
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

#LI-Remote

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page (https://salesloft.com/company/careers/).

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer (all genders)
Your mission

Build the backbone of intelligent energy systems.
You'll develop backend systems that turn complex optimization algorithms into reliable, real-time decisions for industrial energy systems.
From the core APIs of our optimization platform to integrations with energy management systems, you make sure our platform runs fast, stable and reliable. Your work lets our customers intelligently control and optimize battery storage, photovoltaic systems, charging infrastructure and other energy assets.
This isn't a job building standard CRUD applications. You'll work on the technological core of our product, where architecture decisions directly shape performance, scalability and the success of our solution.

Develop backend systems
You'll design, build and improve the central services of our optimization platform. You'll work on core APIs, orchestration logic and the interfaces between our systems, always aiming for robust, high-performing and maintainable solutions.

Own APIs and integrations
You'll integrate external energy management systems (EMS), partner solutions and customer systems. You'll build clean, well-documented APIs and handle the problems that come up in real-world use, such as incomplete data, retry mechanisms and outages of individual systems.

Help shape infrastructure and operations
You take responsibility for keeping our services reliable in production. From CI/CD and our cloud infrastructure (Heroku / AWS) to monitoring, alerting and performance tuning, you keep everything running smoothly.

Make systems scalable
You design systems from the start to grow with our customers. You spot bottlenecks early, improve observability, and keep our platform stable and fast as complexity grows.

Deliver features end to end
You'll work in a small, cross-functional team with a strong on-site focus. You'll own features through the whole development process, from the first idea through design and implementation to deployment and monitoring.

Raise the technical bar
You bring your experience to the table and set high technical standards. You help shape architecture decisions, share knowledge with the team, and help backend engineering at EnopAI keep getting better.


Your profile

  • At least 7 years of experience building and running production backend systems.
  • Excellent Python skills and solid experience with FastAPI, asyncio, relational databases and frameworks such as SQLAlchemy.
  • AI-first mindset: you use AI and AI agents as a normal part of your daily development work to speed up boilerplate, tests and refactoring, so you have more time for architecture, product and hard technical problems.
  • Cloud and DevOps experience: you're confident working in cloud environments and familiar with CI/CD, infrastructure as code and running modern backend systems.
  • A strong sense for architecture. You build solutions that work reliably today and still scale tomorrow, and you know when pragmatism matters more than perfection.
  • Founder mindset: you take ownership, think like an entrepreneur and make technical decisions proactively instead of just implementing requirements.
  • You enjoy working with strong engineers, give constructive feedback and hold your own work and the team's to a high standard.
  • You value the pace of a small team and like working on-site in Munich, because fast decisions and close collaboration make a real difference to you.
  • You speak fluent, business-level German and English.

    Nice to have
    • Experience with InfluxDB or other time-series databases.
    • Interest in energy systems, optimization algorithms or mathematical models.


Why us?

  • The pace of an ambitious startup where your ideas count and you have real influence on product and technology.
  • A competitive salary plus extra benefits such as the EGYM Wellpass.
  • The chance to make a concrete contribution to the energy transition through your work.
  • A central office right at Goetheplatz in Munich, with the option to work from home by arrangement.
  • An environment where you keep growing: together with a strong engineering team, you'll build innovative software, solve challenging technical problems and help shape the future of intelligent energy systems.

jobs.title: Staff AI Deployment Strategist - UK & Nordics
jobs.description:
Staff AI Deployment Strategist - UK & Nordics

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As Staff AI Deployment Strategist, you will shape how some of the most ambitious enterprises in the UK & Nordics region adopt frontier AI at scale.

This is a senior, high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You will work directly on Mistral’s most strategic opportunities and largest deliveries, helping customers move from ambition to measurable business outcomes. You will frame complex AI transformation programs, turn executive priorities into actionable roadmaps, and ensure that Mistral delivers systems that are valuable, scalable, and trusted.

You will also act as a senior sponsor on our most critical customer programs, bringing judgment, structure, and delivery excellence to high-stakes engagements. Your mandate is to raise the ambition and quality of AI adoption: helping customers identify where AI can create step-change value, making the right trade-offs, and ensuring that execution matches the strategic promise.

This role is ideal for an experienced strategy consultant, transformation leader, or senior operator who wants to move from advising on change to building it directly with frontier AI technology.

 

What You Will Do

  • Shape high-impact AI transformations

    • Partner closely with Mistral’s Sales leadership in the UK & Nordics to qualify opportunities, align on account strategy, and drive executive engagement.

    • Work with senior customer stakeholders to identify where frontier AI can create material business value.

    • Structure complex opportunities into clear, credible, and executable transformation programs.

    • Translate strategic ambition into delivery roadmaps, success metrics, and operating plans.

    • Help customers make the right trade-offs between ambition, feasibility, speed, and long-term scalability.

  • Sponsor Mistral’s most strategic deliveries

    • Act as a senior sponsor on the largest and most complex customer programs, primarily in the UK & Nordics and potentially cross-region as priorities evolve.

    • Ensure delivery quality, executive alignment, and measurable business impact.

    • Anticipate risks, unblock decisions, and help teams navigate ambiguity in high-stakes environments.

    • Bring senior judgment to moments where scope, resources, timelines, or expected value need to be clarified.

  • Build repeatable deployment excellence

    • Turn lessons from strategic engagements into reusable approaches, playbooks, and patterns.

    • Raise the bar for how AI programs are qualified, framed, delivered, and scaled.

    • Act as a senior relay for the Solutions organization in the region, helping teams adopt shared best practices, adapt them thoughtfully to local market specificities when needed, and strengthen the quality of execution.

    • Work hand in hand with Solutions leadership to connect customer realities, delivery patterns, and field feedback into practical ways of improving how Mistral deploys AI.

    • Help codify what great enterprise AI deployment looks like across industries and use cases.

    • Contribute to a Solutions culture that combines strategic clarity, technical depth, and strong execution.

  • Develop and multiply senior DS impact

    • Coach Deployment Strategists on strategic problem-solving, executive communication, and delivery leadership.

    • Help teams raise the quality of their work on the highest-impact opportunities.

    • Identify capability gaps and contribute to hiring, staffing, and development priorities.

    • Act as a force multiplier across accounts, teams, and regions where your experience can have the highest leverage.

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

You are a senior, highly capable professional with strong executive presence, excellent business judgment, and a track record of leading complex strategic or transformation work.

Typical indicators we’re looking for include:

  • 8–10+ years of professional experience in strategy consulting, digital transformation, AI, enterprise technology, or a similarly demanding environment.

  • Experience operating at Partner, Principal, Engagement Manager, Director, or equivalent level in a top-tier strategy consulting or transformation context.

  • A strong ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify value, and turn strategy into execution.

  • Experience leading large accounts, complex programs, or senior customer relationships.

  • The credibility to engage with executives and C-level stakeholders on business priorities, trade-offs, and impact.

  • Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.

  • Comfort working at the frontier of technology, even when solutions are evolving quickly and the path is not fully defined.

  • A low-ego, high-ownership mindset and a desire to build with customers and teams, not just advise from a distance.

  • Fluency in English; German is a strong plus.

 

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview 

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

  • Design and orchestrate agents and multi-agent workflows, including task decomposition, tool use, agent hand-offs and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

  • Connect agents to internal systems, databases and APIs, for example through MCP or function calling.

  • Evaluate AI output for accuracy, regression, cost and latency, and refine workflows based on results.

  • Apply appropriate safeguards for data privacy, security and hallucination risk, particularly when customer or school data is involved.

jobs.description:
Senior Scientific Data Engineer

About TetraScience

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world’s leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience’s growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft.

In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review “The Tetra Way,” authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you.

What You Will Do

You will join TetraScience's forward deployed teams as a senior, hands-on engineer. In this role, you will work directly with biotech, pharmaceutical, and scientific companies, bringing advanced data and AI technologies into the labs that research, develop, and manufacture medicines. You will work alongside customer scientific, engineering, and IT teams to design, build, and ship integrations and data products on Tetra OS that serve scientific teams across the globe. You will also mentor other scientific data engineers, lead internal design sessions, and partner with Product Managers and Solution Architects to turn customer, product, and engineering objectives into commercialized solutions.

  • Act as a forward deployed engineer for a portfolio of biotech, pharmaceutical, and scientific customers. Own the technical relationship, understand their scientific workflows, and deliver solutions that move their programs forward.
  • Drive AI agents to design and build bidirectional integrations between Tetra OS and customer systems such as ELN, LIMS, MES, and process historians, including serverless push and pull pipelines, stateful connectors, and full stack data applications in Python and TypeScript.
  • Drive AI agents to design and build comprehensive data schemas and parsers for scientific data from R&D lab instruments, manufacturing, CRO, CDMO, ELN, and LIMS sources, across formats such as .xlsx, .pdf, .txt, .raw, .fid, and many other vendor binaries.
  • Deploy and test solutions in customer environments, including cloud, on-premises, and hybrid networks, and troubleshoot across the full stack when something breaks.
  • Create and enforce designs with quality backed by comprehensive test automation to prove expected behaviors.
  • Lead process and technology improvements supporting product quality, developer experience, and platform capabilities.
  • Provide mentorship to junior scientific data engineers and show leadership on every front.

jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.description:
UX Designer

Of je jezelf nu UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer noemt: jij zorgt ervoor dat digitale producten en services logisch werken voor de mensen die ze gebruiken. Je beweegt makkelijk tussen strategie, gebruikersbehoeften, interactie en technologie. Van eerste inzicht en concept tot een uitgewerkt ontwerp dat daadwerkelijk gebouwd en gebruikt wordt.

Wat ga je doen als UX Designer bij Norday?

Bij Norday werken we aan complexe vraagstukken waarvoor niet altijd meteen duidelijk is wat de juiste oplossing is. Nieuwe technologie, veranderende verwachtingen en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen vragen organisaties om richting te kiezen én die richting concreet te maken.

Als UX Designer help jij daarbij. Je vergroot de verbeeldingskracht van opdrachtgevers met scherpe inzichten en snelle prototypes. Je onderzoekt wat mensen nodig hebben, maakt complexe informatie begrijpelijk en vertaalt strategische keuzes naar digitale producten en services die in de praktijk werken. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met strategen, service designers, visual designers, developers en projectmanagers.

Je werkt aan nieuwe digitale platforms, slimme tools, gepersonaliseerde ervaringen en nieuwe diensten. Soms ligt er al een duidelijke strategie, soms help je die samen met het team verder vormgeven. Je bent gedurende het hele proces betrokken: van het eerste vraagstuk en onderzoek tot concept, ontwerp, validatie en realisatie.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Je duikt in de context van een vraagstuk en brengt gebruikers, behoeften, doelen en knelpunten in kaart;

  • Je vertaalt inzichten en strategie naar een concept, user flows, journeys en prototypes;

  • Je maakt complexe vraagstukken begrijpelijk en helpt klanten en teams om keuzes te maken;

  • Je faciliteert workshops en co-creatiesessies met klanten, gebruikers en collega’s;

  • Je bedenkt en test verschillende oplossingsrichtingen en gebruikt inzichten uit onderzoek om je ontwerp steeds verder aan te scherpen;

  • Je onderzoekt hoe AI kan bijdragen aan nieuwe diensten, betere ervaringen en waarde voor organisaties en de mensen die ze gebruiken;

  • Je zorgt dat interacties, flows en details helder zijn voor visual designers, developers én agents;

  • Je bewaakt de gebruikerservaring tot het product of de service daadwerkelijk werkt;

  • Je werkt samen met strategen en andere disciplines aan oplossingen die niet alleen prettig werken, maar bijdragen aan de richting en waarde van de organisatie.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe mensen dingen gebruiken en waarom ze bepaalde keuzes maken. Je kunt goed luisteren, doorvragen en verbanden leggen. Tegelijkertijd ben je niet iemand die eindeloos blijft onderzoeken: je krijgt energie van het concreet maken van inzichten en het samenbrengen van verschillende perspectieven in een heldere oplossing.

  • Je kunt schakelen tussen het grotere verhaal en het detail. Je begrijpt wat een strategische keuze betekent voor een gebruikerservaring en weet wat er nodig is om een idee technisch en organisatorisch haalbaar te maken.

  • Je bent zelfstandig in je werk, zoekt actief de samenwerking op en kunt je ontwerpkeuzes goed uitleggen aan zowel klanten als collega’s. Je hoeft niet overal het antwoord op te hebben. Wel wil je begrijpen wat er speelt en samen tot een oplossing komen die klopt.

Onze ideale UX Designer …

  • heeft een aantal jaar ervaring als UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer;

  • heeft ervaring met complexe digitale vraagstukken en het ontwerpen van digitale producten of services;

  • kan zelfstandig onderzoek, conceptontwikkeling, interaction design en prototyping oppakken;

  • heeft ruime ervaring met Figma en bijvoorbeeld Miro of vergelijkbare tools;

  • vindt het leuk om workshops en co-creatiesessies te begeleiden;

  • kan goed samenwerken met strategen, service designers, visual designers en developers;

  • beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed, vanwege de grote mate van klantcontact, interviews, workshops en samenwerking;

  • heeft een HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld vanuit CMD, Design for Interaction of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • is nieuwsgierig naar de mogelijkheden van AI en experimenteert ermee in eigen processen. Je ziet AI als een nieuwe manier om onderzoek te doen, samen te werken, te ontwerpen en ideeën sneller te verkennen en toetsen.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris van €3.600 tot €4.700 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring;

  • Hybride werken vanuit Rotterdam en thuis;

  • Een persoonlijk budget van €750 voor je thuiswerkplek;

  • 25 vakantiedagen;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling en leasefietsregeling;

  • Een NS Business Card;

  • Een persoonlijk leer- en ontwikkelplan en veel ruimte om te leren van collega’s en vakexperts;

  • Afwisselende projecten waarin strategie, design, technologie en domeinkennis samenkomen;

  • Een team van nieuwsgierige en betrokken collega’s die kwaliteit belangrijk vinden;

  • De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Norday.

Norday stimuleert een diverse werkomgeving en is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We moedigen sollicitanten van alle achtergronden en identiteiten aan om te solliciteren. Daarnaast nemen we sociale en ecologische impact mee in onze besluitvorming en in jouw performance reviews.

Vragen? Neem dan contact met ons op via 010 221 46 00 of

Norday: Ready to Lead

Norday helpt organisaties richting te geven aan verandering en hun veranderkracht te vergroten. We combineren strategie, design, technologie en domeinkennis om complexe vraagstukken concreet te maken en oplossingen te ontwikkelen die in de praktijk werken. Van transformatiestrategie, digitale en datastrategie tot nieuwe producten, diensten en AI-toepassingen: we gidsen organisaties bij waar ze naartoe willen en helpen ze om daar te komen.

We werken in multidisciplinaire teams samen met opdrachtgevers in cultuur, zorg en welzijn, educatie, overheden, NGO’s en climate tech aan de grote vraagstukken van deze tijd. Daarbij verbinden we de mogelijkheden van technologie met de context van organisaties en de mensen die ermee werken. Norday is onderdeel van Handpicked en een B Corp.
