jobs.title: Afstudeerstage IT
jobs.description:
Afstudeerstage IT

Bij BAS, Europa’s grootste dealer in commerciële voertuigen én officieel Volvo en Renault Trucks dealer, krijg jij de kans om je te ontwikkelen binnen IT in de automotive branche. Ben jij op zoek naar een afstudeerstage vanaf januari/ februari 2027? Dan is dit iets voor jou!

BAS World groeit hard, en IT speelt daarin een sleutelrol. Binnen ons IT-team liggen verschillende afstudeeropdrachten klaar die elk een echt vraagstuk uit ons IT-landschap aanpakken. Elke opdracht heeft een eigen team dat je dagelijks begeleidt. Zo breng je je kennis in de praktijk en kickstart je samen met ons jouw carrière.

Mogelijke afstudeeropdrachten

1. Continuous performance & load testing (Engineering)
BAS World wil het aantal voertuigadvertenties online ongeveer 20 keer zo groot maken. In deze opdracht zorg je dat onze websites en systemen die groei aankunnen. Je onderzoekt welke (AI-gedreven) testtools passen bij onze stack. Daarna bouw je samen met het IDP-team een testsuite die dagelijks automatisch draait in de pipeline. Het resultaat is een productieklare testopzet en een advies over knelpunten en capaciteit.
Past bij: Software Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure.

2. Kleine AI-agents voor de business (Data / AI engineering)
In deze opdracht werk je als interne consultant binnen één afdeling, bijvoorbeeld Logistiek. Je spreekt gebruikers, brengt hun processen en knelpunten in kaart en bepaalt waar AI het meeste oplevert. Daarna bouw je één of meer kleine AI-agents op basis van de services en data die we al hebben. Je test ze en verbetert ze tot ze echt gebruikt worden in het dagelijkse werk.
Past bij: AI, Data Science, Business IT, Software Engineering, als je graag dicht op eindgebruikers werkt.

3. Realtime monitoring & bottleneck-analyse voor Thinkwise-applicaties (Engineering)
Verschillende kernapplicaties draaien op het low-code platform Thinkwise. Als gebruikers traagheid melden, kost het nu weken om de oorzaak te vinden. In deze opdracht bouw je monitoring die de performance over de hele stack realtime inzichtelijk maakt: van UI en applicatielaag tot database en netwerk. Die performance komt live op een scherm op de werkvloer van onze developers. Daarnaast ontwikkel je rapportage- en analysetooling waarmee developers bottlenecks precies kunnen aanwijzen en oplossen waar ze ontstaan. Zo vinden we problemen in uren in plaats van weken.
Past bij: Software Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps, met interesse in performance en observability.

4. Problem management & ITSM-procesoptimalisatie (System & Application Management)
Onze Servicedesk en het S&AM-team krijgen veel meldingen binnen in Jira. Terugkerende problemen worden nog te weinig bij de bron opgelost. In deze opdracht breng je de ITSM-processen in kaart en leg je ze vast: processtromen, werkinstructies en rollen. Je toetst ze aan good practices zoals ITIL. Daarna ontwerp en implementeer je problem management als een vast proces, zodat terugkerende issues structureel verdwijnen.
Past bij: Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of verwant.

5. Datagedreven leadgeneratie met FleetCareXL & BAS World (Product)
Via FleetCareXL weten we precies hoe voertuigen onderhouden worden en wat dat kost. De verkoophistorie van BAS World vertelt ons veel over restwaardes. In deze opdracht combineer je deze twee databronnen in een proof of concept. Die berekent het ideale vervangmoment: wanneer onderhoudskosten gaan stijgen terwijl de restwaarde nog hoog is. Dat levert kostenbesparing op voor klanten en leads voor in- en verkoop. De opdracht kan ook andersom worden ingevuld. Dan onderzoek je hoe we FleetGuide selfservice of fullservice actief kunnen aanbieden aan klanten van BAS World.
Past bij: Data Science, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, met commerciële interesse.

Kortom: veel verantwoordelijkheid, veel samenwerking en een opdracht met echte impact.

Wij bieden jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto per maand voor een fulltime stage én reiskostenvergoeding;

  • Een inhoudelijke en uitdagende afstudeeropdracht met zichtbare impact;

  • Dagelijkse begeleiding vanuit het team dat jouw opdracht host;

  • De mogelijkheid om onderdeel uit te maken van ons gedreven en enthousiaste IT-team;

  • Bij goede prestaties uitzicht op een vaste functie binnen BAS. Bij BAS zeggen we namelijk niet voor niets: “Bij BAS heb je geen baan maar een carrière!”;

  • Een vaste kruk bij de VrijMiBo en jouw naam op de gastenlijst voor onze bedrijfsuitjes en feestjes.


  • Je volgt een HBO-opleiding richting Software Engineering, DevOps, Data Science, AI, Business IT & Management, IT Service Management of een gerelateerde opleiding;

  • Je bent woonachtig in de omgeving van Veghel.

  • Je vindt het leuk om systemen en processen te verbeteren en oplossingen te bouwen die echt gebruikt worden;

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en hebt de drive om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Wij zijn BAS!

We zijn actief sinds 1962. Sindsdien vestigden wij onze naam als een betrouwbare kracht in de Automotive. Als familiebedrijf zijn wij wereldwijd actief in kopen, onderhouden en verkopen van vrachtwagens, trekkers, trailers, bouwmachines, bedrijfswagens en landbouwmachines.

Al onze kennis en ervaring verwerkten we daarnaast in de ontwikkeling van basworld.com. Hier verbinden we kopers en verkopers met elkaar en helpen we hen om snel, gemakkelijk en veilig te handelen. Onze ambitie voor BAS kent geen grenzen. Rijd jij voorop om BAS naar het volgende niveau te brengen?

Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop.

jobs.title: Stagiair(e) Marketing

Stagiair(e) Marketing

Volg jij een opleiding in marketing, AI, communicatie, (creative) business of een vergelijkbare studie? Heb je interesse in een focus op content of growth marketing?

We hebben jouw creativiteit en vernieuwende ideeën nodig! Wij zijn namelijk op zoek naar een creatieve student die ons helpt met het maken van marketingcampagnes in woord én beeld. Dit betekent een focus op content creatie en/of growth marketing.

Wat ga je doen?

Dat bepaal je voornamelijk zelf! Afhankelijk van je opleiding en interesses stellen we een takenpakket samen dat aansluit bij de uitdagingen, doelstellingen en projecten die spelen binnen ons team. Is AI je beste vriend? Mooi, daar kunnen we nog veel in ontwikkelingen. Interesse in de Socials? Fijn, we kunnen je creativiteit goed gebruiken. Vlotte pen? Ook prima! Jouw teksten krijgen bij ons het podium dat ze verdienen.

Kortom, afhankelijk van jouw input, ideeën en talenten kijken we samen wat je gaat doen, zoals:

  • Vormgeving;

  • Webinarproducties;

  • Website-optimalisatie en -onderhoud;

  • E-mail marketing; 

  • Social media; 

  • Deep dive in de analytics;

  • Meedenken in plannen rondom AI.

Vanaf dag één nemen we je bij de hand en laten je zien hoe de praktijk werkt. Maar na verloop van tijd kun jij het (bijna) helemaal zelf en vertel je ons hoe het beter kan.

Met wie werk je samen?
Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor. Wij zijn onlangs gegroeid tot een team van zeven enthousiaste marketeers met ieder een eigen specialisme. Genoeg mogelijkheden dus om samen te groeien en van elkaar te leren. 

Maud over haar stage bij 12Build:

“12Build is voor mij een plek waar ik mezelf kan en mag ontwikkelen. Ik voel me vanaf het eerste moment welkom in een super leuk team. Er is fijne begeleiding, ruimte om vragen te stellen en feedback te geven/ontvangen. De kernwaarden Happiness, Openness en Drive voel je als je hier binnen stapt.”

Wie is 12Build?
12Build in het kort: Met een flinke portie Drive, Happiness en Openness bouwen wij aan een transparante bouwbranche. Wij zijn een SaaS platform dat bouwbedrijven verbindt en zo de samenwerking bevordert. We bestaan al bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds. Inmiddels zijn we met meer dan 90 collega’s, verdeeld over 2 kantoren (Nijverdal en Zwolle). Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software op dagelijkse basis. jobs.description:
Founding Platform Engineer

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a fast-growing innovator in the crypto and decentralized finance space who is seeking a Founding Platform Engineer (Staff+ level) to join the team. This organization is behind a leading decentralized exchange (DEX) on HyperEVM, having achieved significant revenue milestones with an ultra-lean team. The client is now expanding its technical architecture to build an advanced, mobile-first crypto trading platform (spot + perps) alongside a novel, original social product featuring cutting-edge mechanisms.

As the first and only engineer in this specialized domain, the incoming candidate will take an original product vision and turn it into a robust, high-performance system—holding the entire architecture and the smallest details simultaneously. The operational environment is primarily asynchronous, highly independent, and built for top-tier developers who can scale infrastructure from zero to massive daily trading volumes while maintaining absolute reliability.

Requirements

  • Platform Ownership: Own the core platform, including the data layer, rewards engine, notifications, the API surface, and overall system reliability.
  • Trading Engine Integration: Integrate perpetual trading engines through Hyperliquid, alongside spot trading via Jupiter and Relay.
  • Data Harmonization: Aggregate and unify conflicting data providers (such as Zerion, CoinGecko, Mobula, Alchemy, and Hyperliquid) into a single, cohesive source of truth.
  • High-Performance Data Delivery: Serve heavy data rapidly by implementing resilient caching mechanisms that survive traffic stampedes and fan-out structures that hold under pressure.
  • Cross-Chain Abstraction: Design architecture that makes a single USDC balance across multiple chains entirely invisible and seamless to the end user.
  • Peak Performance & Reliability: Maintain absolute uptime during peak market volatility; ensure the application never lags or crashes when it matters most, guaranteeing users can always close positions.

﻿

Requirements

  • Proven track record of engineering resilience, including keeping a high-stakes system alive through massive traffic spikes and determining graceful degradation strategies in advance.
  • Extensive experience building financial rewards and accounting systems that withstand retries, prioritizing idempotency, replay safety, and precise lot tracking.
  • Deep understanding of end-to-end latency budgets (from a user's tap to screen rendering).
  • Advanced database optimization skills, capable of resolving bottlenecks directly within PostgreSQL rather than relying on secondary databases.
  • Strong proficiency in Rust development.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment across North American or European timezones.

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. An overview of this role

As an Strategic Account Executive, you’ll help expand GitLab’s presence across the Public Sector in Brazil by building trusted relationships with senior leaders at large organizations and guiding them through complex platform decisions. You’ll use a consultative sales approach to connect customer business needs with our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, helping teams improve developer productivity, reduce security and compliance risk, and move software delivery forward with more confidence. In this role, you’ll support strategic accounts across the full customer journey, from early conversations through adoption, while helping us position GitLab as a leading DevSecOps partner in the Brazilian market.

You’ll work across pre-sales, post-sales, partner, marketing, and support teams, and we’ll rely on you to bring strong account leadership, customer outcomes, and clear communication in English and Portuguese. Over your first year, your impact will come from building account plans for large organizations, developing new opportunities, and helping customers successfully adopt GitLab in ways that align to their business goals.

  • Lead strategic account activity for prospects and customers across the Public Sector in Brazil, providing direction throughout pre-sales and post-sales engagements.

  • Collaborate with marketing, account teams, product managers, and technical teams to share lessons learned and communicate customer needs clearly.

The team focuses on growing GitLab’s Public Sector business in Brazil by helping organizations adopt a single platform for software delivery, security, and collaboration. This role works closely with cross-functional partners across sales, solutions, support, marketing, and product, and contributes to an asynchronous, distributed way of working that values transparency, accountability, and shared customer insight. The team’s work sits at the intersection of strategic growth and customer transformation, with a focus on helping Public Sector organizations evaluate, adopt, and expand their use of GitLab across complex environments.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist · Paid Social, KI-native (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Creative Strategist · Paid Social, KI-native (m/w/d)

Warum es diese Stelle gibt

Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat begleiten.

Ich bin Linus, einer der beiden Gründer und habe die Creatives für unsere Ads bisher zum großen Teil selbst gemacht. Das Marketing wächst schneller, als ich es neben allem anderen leisten kann. Deshalb suche ich die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt und mit uns ausbaut.

Was du machst

  • Den Markt beobachten: was die Konkurrenz in Deutschland und im Ausland schaltet und was im Abnehmmarkt außerhalb der Medizin funktioniert.

  • Daraus testbare Konzepte machen, jeweils mit klarer Hypothese und mehreren Hooks, und davon jede Woche neue an den Start bringen.

  • Creatives selbst bauen, vor allem mit KI: Statics, Animationen und Schnitte aus vorhandenem Material.

  • Drehs organisieren, mit uns Gründern, unserem Team und UGC-Creator, von Briefing und Skript bis zur Abnahme.

  • Auswerten, was läuft und daraus die nächste Runde ableiten.

  • Später dazu: unseren Newsletter und Shortform-Content für TikTok und Reels.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Woche 1: deine erste eigene Ad ist live.

  • Monat 1: Marktbeobachtung und Ideenplanung laufen über dich und jede Woche gehen neue Tests von dir raus.

  • Monat 3: du gibst deine Ads selbst frei, kennst die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich sicher und hast einen Plan, wie wir organisch auf Shortform wachsen.

Wen wir suchen

jobs.description:
Senior Recruiter - Vollzeit (m/w/d)


Ab sofort suchen wir einen Senior Recruiter - Vollzeit (m/w/d) in Vollzeit an unserem Standort in der Hamburger Innenstadt.

In dieser Position führst du strukturierte Qualifizierungsgespräche mit Bewerbern durch, die wir über Social-Media-Kampagnen für unsere Kunden generieren. Du prüfst, ob ein Bewerber fachlich und persönlich zum jeweiligen Unternehmen passt – und übernimmst anschließend die Terminierung der Vorstellungsgespräche.
Diese Rolle erfordert Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Prozesssicherheit und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Projektmanagern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden nur passende Bewerber vorgestellt bekommen.

Was macht die Cordes Consulting GmbH genau?

Wir sind eine Werbeagentur, welche Handwerksunternehmen durch innovative Social-Media-Strategien dabei hilft, mehr Bewerbungen von Fachkräften aus der Region zu erhalten. Wir vermarkten also mittelständische Unternehmen als attraktive Arbeitgeber in den sozialen Netzwerken und generieren für diese Bewerbungen für ihre handwerklichen Stellen. Dazu suchen wir neue Recruiter (m/w/d), um diese Bewerber zu kontaktieren und Bewerbungsgespräche bei unseren Kunden zu terminieren.

Aufgabengebiete:

  • Du führst telefonische Vorgespräche mit Bewerbern, die wir über unsere Kampagnen generieren

  • Du prüfst, ob die Bewerber für die jeweilige Stelle geeignet sind – anhand klarer Kriterien

  • Du triffst eine Vorauswahl und organisierst Vorstellungsgespräche bei unseren Kunden

  • Du dokumentierst alle Gesprächsergebnisse sorgfältig in unserem Bewerbermanagementsystem

  • Du übermittelst den Bewerbern relevante Informationen zum Job und zum Arbeitgeber

  • Du arbeitest nach festen Gesprächsleitfäden und standardisierten Prozessen

Wenn du weitere Informationen zu unserem Unternehmen und deiner Karriere bei Cordes Consulting haben möchtest, findest du diese auf www.cordes-karriere.de.

Das erwartet Dich bei uns:

  • Eine gute Vergütung über dem Branchendurchschnitt.

  • Hervorragende Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter stark wachsen.

  • Einen tollen Firmenstandort in der Hamburger Innenstadt mit moderner Arbeitsausstattung.

  • Eine tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Uns ist ein positives Umfeld wichtig. Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang.

  • Ein dynamisches Team ein motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld.

  • Einen sichereren Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.

  • Eine erstklassige Büroausstattung: Wir arbeiten ausschließlich mit moderner Technik und Arbeitsausstattung.

  • Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket oder einen Tiefgaragenstellplatz in unserem Bürogebäude.

  • Cordes Consulting Gesundheitssystem: Profitiere von umfangreichen Gesundheitsleistungen für dich und deine Familienangehörigen (u. a. 900 € jährliches Gesundheitsbudget für Privatleistungen, Facharzt-Terminvereinbarung innerhalb von 5-10 Tagen, ärztliche Zweitmeinung sowie ein 24/7 Gesundheitstelefon)

  • Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung (mindestens 5 Jahre) in den Themenbereichen Recruiting, Projektmanagement oder Personalmarketing

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior AI Engineer

Bally’s Intralot is a newly formed company established through the combination of Intralot and Bally’s International Interactive, positioning the group as a top iGaming operator and a leading global provider of lottery solutions.

Bally’s Intralot is uniquely positioned across digital online gaming markets, lottery, iLottery, and sports betting. Operating at the intersection of technology, regulation, and entertainment. We are optimally positioned to capitalise on strong global growth trends driven by digital adoption and regulatory expansion across lottery and iGaming markets.

Well, what about the team?

Join our AI Transformation team to create new capabilities and rethink how teams across Product and Technology work. Our programme aims to help teams ship faster, improve quality, reduce the effort and cost of delivery, build products that strengthen our competitive position, and develop our people’s skills. We turn promising ideas into working products and practices that teams can adopt and reuse across the business.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be empowered to identify opportunities, propose ideas and build new products, tools and ways of working. You will take ownership of your own initiatives, from a clear hypothesis and agreed success measures through experimentation, production delivery and learning. Alongside this, you will work with engineering teams to turn their prototypes into reliable production products, own shared transformation tooling, and showcase new approaches through demos, tech talks, workshops and pairing. This role combines the creativity to see what could be different with the engineering judgement and drive to make it happen.

So, what will you be doing?

  • Originate and build new capabilities: Proactively identify opportunities across Product and Technology, turn them into practical proposals, and build products, internal tools, automations and agents that create value. Own selected initiatives from discovery through delivery, working with stakeholders to connect each idea to a clear programme outcome.

  • Run experiments that lead to decisions: State the opportunity and hypothesis, then agree the success measure and threshold before building. Create the smallest useful experiment, use a feature flag or controlled rollout where appropriate, and measure against a control or baseline at an agreed review date. Use the evidence to scale, change or stop the work.

  • Take prototypes into production: Deliver your own successful experiments and partner with engineering teams to productionise theirs. Resolve architecture, integration, testing, security and operational gaps, agree production-readiness criteria, and work through release and handover with the teams that will own and operate the resulting products.

  • Improve how teams build software: Redesign planning, development, testing, review and delivery around the capabilities of AI. Build and trial approaches such as specification-driven development and agent-assisted workflows, then turn successful work into reusable skills, reference implementations, connectors and engineering patterns that teams can adapt.

  • Own shared transformation tooling: Build and maintain the programme’s shared applications, APIs, integrations and analytics on AWS, including the Radar and Tracker and connections to engineering and collaboration systems. Keep these services reliable, maintainable and useful to activity owners and programme leaders.

  • Champion practical AI engineering: Showcase emerging approaches and techniques through regular demos, tech talks, workshops, pairing and clear written guides. Share working examples, explain trade-offs and limitations, and turn successful experiments into practices that other teams can use.

  • Evaluate tools and approaches: Keep up with developments in AI engineering, test them against real team needs, and recommend adoption based on evidence. Consider quality, cost, security and portability, helping teams retain flexibility as tools, models and pricing change.

  • Embed quality and responsible use: Work with Platform, SRE, Cyber and governance colleagues to build evaluation, observability, access controls and appropriate human oversight into AI-enabled services and workflows. Help teams understand failure modes and make support, recovery and ownership arrangements clear.

  • Develop capability in others: Mentor graduate and less experienced engineers, and work with learning and enablement colleagues to address practical skills gaps. Build teams’ confidence and ability to maintain what they adopt.


And what will you need?

  • Software engineering and delivery: Strong Python or TypeScript skills and experience taking prototypes into production, including APIs, cloud deployment (preferably AWS), automated testing, CI/CD and observability.

  • Practical AI engineering: Experience building LLM applications, agents or automations, using AI coding tools effectively, and improving results through evals and error analysis. Familiarity with context, reusable skills and integrations through APIs or MCP.

  • Initiative and product judgement: Evidence of spotting opportunities, creating useful solutions without a fully defined brief, and owning delivery from idea to outcome.

  • Experimentation and evaluation: Ability to define hypotheses and success measures before building, run focused experiments against a baseline or control, and use evidence to decide what happens next.

  • Sound engineering judgement: Ability to balance quality, reliability, security and cost, evaluate AI behaviour, and choose maintainable solutions with appropriate data access and human oversight.

  • Technical evangelism and collaboration: Clear communication through demos, tech talks, workshops and written guides. Experience partnering with teams, mentoring engineers and helping others adopt effective practices.

What benefits will you get?  

  • 25 days annual leave, plus the bank holiday allowance.

  • Health insurance.

  • Volunteering days.

  • Home office allowance.

  • Wellness or Gym allowance.

  • Flexi-block policy allowing you to work abroad for up to four weeks a year. 

DNA / Values:

At Bally’s Intralot we are driven by a set of core values that we like to call our DNA. We strive to embody our DNA and keep them at the heart of everything we do!

We Win as One, we succeed together - across every location and every function. We collaborate openly, raise each other up, and share the wins. We're Powered by Curiosity, we ask questions, challenge assumptions and make space to learn and innovate. We have Fun with Purpose, we bring creativity, energy and joy to how we work and what we deliver, because when people enjoy what they do, the work is better for everyone. Our teams Embrace the Possibility, when opportunity appears, we act. When the unexpected hits, we adapt. We don’t wait for change - we move towards it. At Bally's Intralot, we Guard the Game, we protect what matters most,  fair play for our players, integrity for our partners, and accountability in everything we do.

Equal Opportunities

At Bally’s Intralot, we are committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment and working conditions. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are important to us, and we encourage a culture where everyone can be themselves at work. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success, this is our superpower.
We do not discriminate against employees or job applicants on the basis of race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, age, sex or sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, political opinion or disability.

Head of Product Marketing Management (London)

UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services. 

We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

Our values ✨

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

UpSlide is a productivity platform for Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel and Word) built for financial professionals in investment banking, private equity, asset management and advisory. Product Marketing sits at the centre of Product, Sales and Marketing: we decide how UpSlide is positioned, priced and sold.

You'll join as our Head of Product Marketing, reporting directly to Matteo Bordin, our Chief Product Officer.

You'll manage one PMM and over time grow your team.

Day-to-day, you'll work closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing leadership. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set direction and still get into the work.

Team goals 🎯

Product Marketing's job is to make UpSlide easy to understand, easy to sell, and priced right. Concretely, that means:

  • Sharpen positioning and messaging so prospects grasp the value fast.

  • Arm Sales to win, especially against direct competitors.

  • Own pricing and packaging decisions and the reasoning behind them.

  • Run customer communications that drive adoption and expansion.

The impact on the business is direct: higher win rates, stronger pricing power, shorter sales cycles.

Your responsibilities 🖋️

Positioning & narrative (25%)

  • Own UpSlide's positioning and messaging across segments and personas.

  • Turn product capabilities into a clear story that resonates with financial professionals.

  • Keep messaging consistent across the website, sales materials and campaigns.

Sales enablement & competitive intelligence (25%)

  • Build the enablement that helps Sales qualify, pitch and close: decks, battlecards, objection handling and one-pagers.

  • Own competitive intelligence: track competitors, brief the business, keep our differentiation sharp.

  • Partner with Sales leadership on win/loss analysis and act on what it tells you.

Pricing & packaging (20%)

  • Own pricing and packaging: structure, tiers, and the logic behind them.

  • Run the analysis and make clear recommendations to the exec team.

  • Support Sales on deal-level pricing and commercial strategy.

Customer communications (15%)

  • Own how we communicate with customers: launches, releases and lifecycle comms.

  • Drive adoption and expansion through clear, well-timed messaging.

Team leadership (15%)

  • Lead, coach, and grow the PMM you’ll manage.

  • Set priorities and hold a high bar on output.

Your goals ⚡

First 3 months: Learn the product, customers and competitors in depth. Build relationships with Sales and Product. Audit our current positioning, pricing and enablement, and tell us where the gaps are.

By 6 months: Ship a refreshed positioning and messaging framework. Stand up a repeatable competitive intelligence rhythm. Deliver a first pricing and packaging recommendation.

By 9 months: Have an enablement program running that measurably improves win rates, pricing changes live or in flight, and a customer communications cadence the business relies on.

As UpSlide grows, this role can grow into broader marketing leadership. We'll back you to get there.


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Significant experience in enterprise B2B sales: you've either carried a quota in complex, high-value deals or worked hand in hand with sellers who do. This is a must.

  • A proven product marketing track record: positioning, messaging and sales enablement that moved the needle.

  • Experience owning or heavily influencing pricing and packaging decisions.

  • People leadership experience: you've managed and developed marketers.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, and the judgement to write for an exec audience.

We'd love it if:

  • You've worked in or sold to financial services: investment banking, private equity, asset management, or advisory.

  • You know the Microsoft 365 / productivity software space.

  • You speak French (not mandatory)

✨ If you don't tick all the boxes but you think you'd be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  • First screening with our Talent Acquisition team (30 to 45 min, phone or video): mutual fit and motivation.

  • Manager interview with Matteo Bordin, CPO (45 min to 1h30, video or in person): product thinking and experience.

  • Peer interview with a peer from Product, Marketing, and Sales (~45 min).

  • Case study with Matteo and a Product peer (45 min to 1h30): a deeper problem worked through together.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive!

What we offer

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year)

🏠 Beautiful office: An inspiring eighth-floor corner office near Liverpool Street with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a balcony with a view, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work: 3 days in-office per week

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget

⏰ Flexi-work: Flex your schedule however works (e.g. bank hours across the fortnight to take a Friday off)

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: £45 per month for physical and mental wellness activities

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

  • Flexible return to work options

  • An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent

✈ Holidays: 25 days plus public holidays & a half-day of additional holiday per year of full service (up to 5 additional days)

🪙 Pension: Pension contributions (with matched contributions up to 5% after one year)

🩺 Health insurance: Opportunity to opt into a health insurance plan (Vitality)

jobs.description:
Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
Your mission

You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes.

You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own:

  • Direction. The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline.
  • Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship.
  • Organisation. Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver.
  • Leaders. Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role.
  • Quality. Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it.
  • Product interface. What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets.


Your profile

You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention.

You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services.
  • 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you.
  • Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage.
  • You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume.
  • Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built.


Why us?

LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification.

This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it.

Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like.

You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market.

We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional.

If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us.

Die FormMed HealthCare GmbH entwickelt Mikronährstoff-Präparate für Therapeuten und Ärzte aller Fachrichtungen. Mit über 400 Präparaten bieten wir das größte Mikronährstoff-Konzept Deutschlands. Über 7.000 Ärzte, medizinische Institute und Heilpraktiker arbeiten mit uns zusammen. Das macht FormMed zur Nr. 1 bei Ärzten und Therapeuten in Deutschland.

Es macht Spaß, bei uns zu arbeiten! jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI

About

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

Build and improve ML systems that power our AI-native applications.

Work on classification, retrieval, ranking, personalization and evaluation, taking ownership from model development to production deployment.

This role is for engineers who enjoy solving practical ML problems, improving model quality and shipping reliable systems used by real users.

 

Focus

  • Build and improve ML models for classification, ranking, retrieval and personalization.

  • Develop efficient classifiers and optimize model accuracy, precision, latency and cost.

  • Improve search relevance and context retrieval using embeddings, hybrid search and reranking.

  • Build personalization models that learn from user behavior while respecting privacy.

  • Develop evaluation pipelines, labeled datasets and metrics to measure model quality.

  • Fine-tune and adapt existing models when supported by sufficient data.

  • Build and maintain ML training, inference and deployment pipelines.

  • Debug production issues, monitor model performance and ship improvements based on real-world feedback.

 

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • Embeddings, vector search and ranking models

  • Production ML systems and inference pipelines

 

Ideal Experience

  • Strong foundations in machine learning and modern neural architectures.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production.

  • Experience in classification, ranking, retrieval, recommendation systems or personalization.

  • Understanding of model evaluation, experimentation and performance metrics.

  • Comfortable writing production-quality code and working with real-world datasets.

  • Able to balance model quality, latency, cost and reliability.

  • Strong ownership, problem-solving skills

 

Outcomes

  • ML models in production meet expected accuracy, relevance, latency and reliability targets.

  • Classification and ranking improvements deliver measurable gains in model quality.

  • Evaluation pipelines identify regressions and support reliable model releases.

  • Training, inference and data pipelines are robust, reproducible and maintainable.

  • Model improvements are driven by real-world feedback and measurable results.

  • Collaborates effectively with engineering and product teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, world-class teams. We are a high-talent-density, hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move quickly, balancing high-quality work with continuous learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put a truly magical product into the hands of our users.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted virtually and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior AI Engineer

Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day.

As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands.

  • You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together.

  • You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected.

  • You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law.

  • You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence.

  • You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early.

  • You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster.

  • You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You follow new AI developments closely, but you don’t just follow the herd: you stay critical and aren’t afraid to say so. You can break a complex problem down into smaller pieces and keep oversight of a system with many moving parts. You take ownership, show initiative when things aren’t yet clear and think from the customer’s problem. You enjoy helping others move forward without taking over. And you like working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

  • Extensive experience in software or ML engineering, around 5 years or more. Depth in recent projects counts for more than the number of years.

  • In-depth knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

  • You’ve built LLM applications and run them in production.

  • Solid experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or similar orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer setup (RAG) isn’t enough.

  • You’ve made the quality of LLM systems measurable with evaluation sets and observability, and can give concrete examples. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

  • Strong backend experience, including REST APIs and Postgres databases.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

  • Experience in the legal, tax or another knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

  • A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

  • Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet.

  • Base salary between €5,500 and €6,450 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

  • A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

  • 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

  • A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

  • A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

  • Collective insurance plans.

  • A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

  • Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best.

  • Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization.

Want to know more?

We’d love to tell you all about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you’ll hear from us within 5 working days. Any questions first? Message or call Nadine on 06 28556265.

A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process.

Werken bij een van de Top 3 spelers in Workforce management in Nederland en bijdragen aan snelle ontwikkeling in het buitenland? 
Bij Intus helpen wij onze klanten en hun medewerkers met slimmer plannen. Hierdoor dragen we bij aan het oplossen van één van de belangrijkste maatschappelijke uitdagingen: personeelskrapte. 

Onze producten brengen flexibiliteit en efficiëntie in het planningsproces en dat is fijn voor iedereen. Onze klanten kunnen onze medewerkers optimaal inzetten, terwijl we tegelijkertijd bijdragen aan meer werkgeluk en een gezonde werk-privé balans. Een win-win voor iedereen! 
 
Als projectmanager bij Intus speel je een cruciale rol in projecten bij onze diverse klanten in verschillende markten zoals zorg, overheid, industrie en logistiek. Je structureert en realiseert meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd van begin tot het eind. Dit kan gaan om het begeleiden van onze klanten bij het volledig implementeren van onze software InPlanning bij een nieuwe klant of het begeleiden van een complexe transformatie in het applicatielandschap bij een bestaande klant. Dankzij jouw vermogen om draagvlak te creëren en overzicht te behouden, help je klanten en zorg je voor een efficiënt verloop van de projecten.  
 
Je maakt deel uit van een team van projectmanagers en consultants die verantwoordelijk zijn voor alle projecten in Nederland. Product Owner

In deze rol schakel je veel met interne stakeholders om processen echt te doorgronden. Vervolgens bepaal je hoe we onze tools, waaronder ons ERP-systeem Odoo en Camunda, optimaal kunnen inzetten. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met onze Applicatiebeheerder, die het functionele beheer voor zijn rekening neemt en onze Camunda/Python Developer. Omdat onze developer ook eigen projecten draait, is het fantastisch als jij zelf de taal van developers spreekt of zelfs je eigen Python-code kunt kloppen om snel iets te bouwen of testen.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Ophalen, analyseren en in kaart brengen van requirements bij diverse afdelingen en de MT-laag.

  • Vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen en wensen naar concrete automatiseringsoplossingen.

  • Beheren, prioriteren en structureren van de interne IT-backlog.

  • Samenwerken met de interne Camunda/Python developer en de Applicatiebeheerder om projecten succesvol en vlot op te leveren.

  • Adviseren van de business over procesoptimalisaties en nieuwe automatiseringskansen.

  • Zorgdragen voor een soepele implementatie en adoptie van nieuwe functionaliteiten op de werkvloer.

Over Payter

Bij Payter zijn we pioniers op het gebied van contactloze NFC- en cashless-technologie. Sinds 2007 maken we impact: we hebben het grootste Europese proefproject voor contactloze en mobiele betalingen gelanceerd, en sindsdien maken bedrijven over de hele wereld gebruik van onze oplossingen. We combineren innovatieve technologieën om veilige, duurzame en toekomstbestendige producten te ontwikkelen. Bij Payter krijg je de kans om bij te dragen aan slimme oplossingen die écht verschil maken in een snel veranderende wereld.


  • Je hebt hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en een sterke interesse in IT en bedrijfsprocessen.

  • Je bent communicatief vaardig, stapt makkelijk op mensen af en kunt goed schakelen met zowel de business als technische collega's.

Feasibility Manager

Due to our continued growth, Precision for Medicine is looking for a Senior Feasibility Associate/Feasibility Manager to join our European team. This position can be covered fully remotely in UK, Spain, Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia or Slovakia. The final title, Senior Feasibility Associate or Feasibility Manager, will be determined based on the successful candidate’s experience and demonstrated level of responsibility.

Position Summary:

The Feasibility Manager is a member of Precision for Medicine’s expert Feasibility Department and is responsible for delivering evidence-based feasibility assessments across pre-award, post-award, rescue, and stand-alone engagements.

The role combines clinical and scientific interpretation with operational intelligence and data analysis to develop country, site, patient-pool, and recruitment recommendations. The Feasibility Manager partners with Business Development, Clinical Operations, Medical, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure that recommendations are scientifically credible, operationally realistic, and clearly communicated.

The successful candidate will manage assigned feasibility deliverables, present analyses and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients, and contribute to strategic initiatives that strengthen Precision for Medicine’s feasibility capabilities and competitive position.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead or contribute to feasibility assessments for client requests for proposals.
  • Review clinical protocols, study assumptions, client information, and operational plans for United States and global clinical trials.
  • Conduct and synthesise competitive landscape, historical recruitment, standard-of-care, treatment landscape, epidemiology, country, site, and patient-pool analyses.
  • Translate evidence into clear country, site, enrolment, and operational recommendations.
  • Develop logical, transparent rationales for assumptions and identify important data limitations and feasibility risks.
  • Present feasibility methods, findings, recommendations, and supporting rationale to Business Development colleagues, proposal teams, and clients.
  • Collaborate with internal colleagues, external consultants, data partners, investigators, and sites to gather and interpret feasibility information.
  • Plan, coordinate, and analyse targeted site and investigator outreach, as appropriate.
  • Participate in bid-defence meetings and client discussions.
  • Contribute to the continued development of feasibility methods, data sources, tools, templates, and best practices. Share knowledge and support the development of colleagues within the Feasibility team.
  • Work effectively across functions, therapeutic areas, and geographic regions.
  • Contribute to initiatives that strengthen Precision for Medicine’s scientifically driven approach and client offering.

Required qualifications and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related discipline.
  • At least two years of relevant experience in clinical trial feasibility, clinical operations, site intelligence, epidemiology, clinical research, or a related area.
  • Experience conducting or contributing to clinical trial feasibility analysis and site or country identification.
  • Ability to interpret clinical, scientific, epidemiological, and operational information and develop clear recommendations.
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.
  • Equivalent combinations of education, qualifications, and relevant experience may be considered.

Preferred qualifications and experience

  • Postgraduate degree in life sciences, public health, epidemiology, data science, or a related discipline.
  • Experience supporting global clinical trials.
  • Experience in oncology, rare disease, or other complex clinical-development programs.
  • Experience presenting analyses and recommendations to clients or senior stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with clinical-trial intelligence, epidemiology, site-performance, or claims and real-world-data platforms.

Skills

  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize multiple evidence sources.
  • Ability to develop and communicate a clear rationale for feasibility assumptions and recommendations.
  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of the overall study strategy.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent deliverables, stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Confidence working with web-based data, intelligence, and analytics platforms.
  • Strong ownership of deliverable quality, accuracy, and timeliness.
  • Collaborative working style and ability to operate effectively in a matrix environment.
  • Ability to work independently while seeking input and escalation appropriately.
  • Working knowledge of ICH-GCP principles.

Precision for Medicine brings together clinical-trial execution, scientific expertise, laboratory capabilities, and advanced data sciences to help life sciences organizations improve the speed, cost, and likelihood of successful clinical development. The organization has a strong focus on oncology and rare diseases and offers the opportunity to contribute to complex programs that seek to bring meaningful therapies to patients.

You’ll lead product launches to help amplify Vanta’s presence in the region, and partner closely with our product management team to identify growth opportunities for us to continue building our product. Finally, you’ll partner closely with our GTM organisation to expand Vanta’s footprint and accelerate our growth.

What you’ll do as a Product Marketing Lead at Vanta:

  • Define and manage go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Vanta’s business in EMEA tailored to the unique opportunities across the EMEA region

  • Develop tailored messaging and positioning for EMEA based on market research and customer insights

  • Partner with our EMEA growth team on the development and execution of targeted marketing campaigns, including tailored messaging and content that effectively engage local audiences and drive business objectives

  • Plan and execute large product launches (including GTM enablement of sales and customer success), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale

  • Author compelling content for each stage of the customer journey, from blog posts to sales collateral

  • Talk regularly to Vanta’s customers, analyze your own data, and understand our competitive landscape to help shape the product strategy and roadmap and inform Vanta’s overall EMEA marketing strategy

  • Partner closely with the EMEA team at Vanta – including demand gen, sales, customer success, and product—to help achieve our objectives in the market

  • Refine Vanta’s pricing and packaging based on deep insights around the market, our product value, and customer needs in partnership with finance, operations, product, sales, and customer success

  • Be a strong customer champion, creative marketer, and problem solver

How to be successful in this role:

  • Have 7+ years of Product Marketing experience, with an emphasis on B2B SaaS

  • Have a deep empathy for users and an ability to adapt communication to best reach, engage and differentiate Vanta to your audience

  • Enjoy working with data and pairing those quantitative conclusions with the qualitative conversations you have with users

  • Find delight in understanding how things work and then explaining your newfound knowledge to others

  • Must be based on London or Dublin, this role will be hybrid in-office

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

  • Pension matching

  • 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

  • 8 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Marketing Specialist - fixed term 12m contract
jobs.description:
Senior Digital Marketing Specialist - fixed term 12m contract
Job Description

Base salary:  £33,990 - £43,775 per annum*  

All salaries listed on our roles are based on UK salary bands, however, if you’d like more information on the bands for your country give us a shout.

Senior Digital Marketing Specialist - fixed term 12m contract

A bit about Torchbox

We’re the leading digital marketing agency for UK and international nonprofits. We’re proud to provide digital marketing services to the NHS, Breast Cancer Now, MSI Reproductive Choices, Disasters Emergency Committee, MND Association, Mind, Diabetes UK, MS Society, Oxfam GB and many, many more charities and organisations around the world. This is a great time to join Torchbox. 

Our diverse team of over 120 people is mostly UK-based but with a significant presence in Manila as well as a network of people around the world.

We are on a mission to set a new standard for a purpose-led business. Torchbox is 100% employee-owned - everyone is a co-owner from day one and we are building an amazing, progressive ownership and learning culture. If you are excited about this mission, it’s a great time to join.

We are looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Specialist to join our award winning team on a 12 month fixed term contract.

You’ll be supporting the planning, implementation and reporting of pay-per-click (PPC) and paid social media campaigns for some of the very biggest charities and NGOs. 

This role would suit someone with a few years experience working in a hands-on digital marketing role who is looking to work with organisations who make the world a better place. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Setting up, running and optimising PPC and paid social campaigns.

  • Experience working agency-side.

  • A background in the nonprofit sector or other relevant sector

  • Carry out daily and weekly optimisation on client accounts.

  • Drafting reports to our clients using Google Analytics as your primary measurement tool. 

  • Supporting our Paid Media Account Managers in the delivery of digital marketing campaigns.

  • Working with our Account Managers to deliver ultra accurate and insightful reports. 

  • Working with our Account Managers to maintain existing client relationships.

  • Working on tasks independently as well as part of a team.


Our Senior Digital Marketing Specialists  have the following skills:

Essential

  • Some hands-on experience planning and running PPC and paid social campaigns. You will ideally be able to set up, optimise and report back on Google Ads and Facebook campaigns from day one. 

  • Outstanding client-facing skills. This is a client-facing role, so you’ll be talking to our charities every day on Zoom, and responding to their requests quickly via email and various project management tools.

  • Experience managing multiple projects or accounts concurrently. You will be looking after between 5 and 10 clients, so the ability to juggle workload, quickly switch focus and manage your own time against tight deadlines is essential. 

  • A basic knowledge of Google Analytics. You will be comfortable logging in and using it to report back on the success of your marketing campaigns.

  • Outstanding, error-free written skills. We need to communicate clearly and accurately with our clients, so you’ll need to display attention to detail. 

  • Excellent numerical skills. You will be managing and moving budgets all day every day in response to campaign performance, so you’ll need to know Google Sheets (or Excel). 

What we offer

  • Become a co-owner of Torchbox, shape our success and share in the rewards 

  • Work with awesome clients doing rewarding, purposeful work

  • Competitive salary + annual review + bonuses

  • Ethical pension scheme, with a 6% contribution from Torchbox

  • 27 days holiday, plus public holidays

  • Fully remote, hybrid, office full-time, whatever works for you

  • Training and conference budget to discover new ideas

  • Paid time off to volunteer for causes that matter to you 

  • Health schemes and access to mental health support

  • Electric car salary sacrifice scheme (UK only)

  • Wellness programme and cycle-to-work scheme, alongside other lovely things that are good for you and the environment

  • Some pretty epic socials (virtual and in-person), weekly free veggie lunches in the office  and a bunch of other cool stuff we’d love to tell you about


The money bit 

£33,990 - £43,775 per annum + a tax-free co-owner bonus & profit share 
At Torchbox, you’re not just an employee—you’re a co-owner from day one. We’re 100% employee-owned, which means you get a say in how we run things, and you directly share in our success.

Our total compensation includes:

  • Base Salary: £33,990 -£43,775 per annum

  • Tax-Free Co-Owner Bonus: A guaranteed £3,600 per year, paid quarterly (£900 every 3 months) as well as our Profit Share Scheme.


The application process

The closing date for this role is Monday 26th October 2026.

The application process will consist of 2 stages, these will be:

  • 30-minute first-stage interview, we will ask you more about your previous work experience and skills.  You’ll also get a chance to learn more about Torchbox and the role

  • A 90-minute final stage interview,  this will be a panel interview with 2-3 members of the team. We will delve more into your experience and ask you some competency-based questions. During this stage, we’d like you to complete a written task and a 5-minute presentation, we will send you details in advance.


Everyone is welcome

We’re committed to being an inclusive employer, from recruitment to everyday life.

If you need help or have questions - give us a shout - No agencies, please.

We are looking for a Client Partner to join our Public Sector team

A bit about Torchbox
We build digital products for international NGOs, governments and universities; and we created Wagtail CMS, used by Google, NASA, the NHS and thousands more. 

Our diverse team of over 120 people is mostly UK-based but with a significant presence in Manila as well as a network of people around the world.

We are on a mission to set a new standard for a purpose-led business. Torchbox is 100% employee-owned - everyone is a co-owner from day one and we are building an amazing, progressive ownership and learning culture. If you are excited about this mission, it’s a great time to join.


What we’re looking for

We are seeking an experienced Client Partner to join our team. Your experience might be in Product or Service Ownership, Delivery Management, or Consulting with a digital agency. 

While account management experience is useful, we are particularly looking for candidates with client-side public sector experience, particularly in navigating complex digital projects and helping clients implement the government Service Standard. You’ll have strong experience in helping clients develop and implement effective digital services and interventions.
We recognise that candidates may not have deep expertise in every aspect of the role, so we’re open to different backgrounds. Whether you lean more towards Delivery or Product is less important than your ability to build strong relationships, guide clients through challenges, and contribute to sales efforts.

In this role, progression will be about the complexity and scale of projects and clients rather than a traditional management track. 

We’re generally a curious, creative, and caring team. If you’re passionate about helping public sector clients navigate complex challenges, improve services, and create meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you!


You will:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of public sector clients, ensuring their digital strategies align with their goals.

  • Lead combined multidisciplinary and client teams through exploration, experimentation, and implementation, drawing on relevant research, design, and technical approaches.

  • Provide the strategic direction to support teams in working in agile, iterative ways to achieve the best outcomes.

  • Work alongside a Delivery Manager, enabling you to hold the vision and strategic direction

  • Act as a navigator through relevant sector standards, helping clients understand the Service Standard and what it means for their work.

  • Facilitate conversations and run workshops confidently, getting hands-on with collaborative and multidisciplinary work.

  • Help teams translate policy intent into viable digital products or services that can be operated effectively.

  • Contribute to business development, supporting the growth of our public sector work by identifying opportunities, leading pitches, and shaping proposals.


Core responsibilities

  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with senior public sector stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor across projects

  • Strategic Leadership: Guide clients in developing and implementing strategies that improve public services, exploring new and different approaches to realise positive outcomes and add value.

  • Project Oversight: Oversee planning and execution of digital projects, coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.

  • Business Development: Identify opportunities for growth within existing client accounts and play a key role in securing new projects.

  • Performance Analysis: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to measure impact and inform decision-making.

  • User-centred and agile working: create the conditions for collaborative, multidisciplinary work across research, design, innovation, and enabling technology. 


Skills & Experience

  • Strong understanding of Service Standard approaches, user-centred design disciplines, and iterative working methods.

  • Experience in a Product, Delivery, or Service Lead role with a focus on agile, user-centred service and product development.

  • Ability to build trust and long-term relationships with public sector clients.

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with confidence in presenting to clients and stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a sales-involved role, identifying opportunities and supporting business growth.

  • A results-oriented mindset, with a track record of driving impactful digital projects.


What we offer

  • Work with awesome clients doing rewarding, purposeful work

  • Competitive salary + annual review + bonuses

  • Paid time off to volunteer for causes that matter to you 

  • Health schemes and access to mental health support

  • Electric car salary sacrifice scheme (UK only)

  • Wellness programme and cycle-to-work scheme, alongside other lovely things that are good for you and the environment

  • Some pretty epic socials (virtual and in-person), weekly free veggie lunches in the offices  and a bunch of other cool stuff we’d love to tell you about
